k×k matrix inverted in O(k³), so an unbounded k (one `SEQUENCE(1,16384)` argument) allocated
gigabytes and could abort the process.

27313.name: text_to_file
27313.docs: Arbitrary formula text (names, CF, validation) for a file. Unparseable text is kept.

26078.name: MAX_INFO_CHARS
26078.docs: Longest Info string written, in characters; longer values are cut on a character boundary.

15833.name: push_capped
15833.docs: Pushes `piece` onto `out`, failing once the result exceeds the cell limit.

12128.name: wb_switch_sheet
12128.docs: Switches the active sheet, remembering each sheet's selection.

13436.name: Func
13436.docs: Function name (word immediately followed by `(`), the `(` is consumed.

25062.name: Out
25062.docs: Text being built plus the first repeat-fill position.

721.name: number
721.docs: A number, or `#NUM!` when it is NaN or infinite (Excel never stores those).

8423.name: remember_view
8423.docs: Remembers where the run left its workbook: the active sheet and the selections.

27678.name: group_char_is_over
27678.docs: Effective brace orientation, including the character default and its precedence over position.

28986.name: selected_workbook_view
28986.docs:
The single window modelled by GridCraft: prefer the first visible window,
including the format's default visibility, and otherwise retain the first one.

16198.name: fill
16198.docs: The DrawingML fill of every run (`<a:solidFill>…</a:solidFill>`), or empty.

25208.name: CAPACITY
25208.docs: Most codes kept per thread. A full cache is emptied, so memory stays bounded.

12420.name: show_window
12420.docs:
Makes a window the one commands act on while the interface draws it, without counting as
an activation: the most recently active window of each workbook stays the same.

940.name: MAX_CONCAT_ARRAY_BYTES
940.docs:
Text bytes that one `&` over arrays may produce in all. Each piece is capped on its own, but a
compact formula can broadcast a long text across millions of cells
(`SEQUENCE(4000,4000)&REPT("x",30000)` is 480 GB): past this the whole result is `#NUM!`, the
error for a result too large to hold, before the rest is built.

7407.name: refuse_unless_allowed
7407.docs:
Refuses an action a protected sheet does not allow, by the tick box for it in Review ▸ Protect
Sheet. `what` names the action in the message. An unprotected sheet allows everything.

Cell edits are guarded separately, by whether the cell is locked (`locked_cell_error`): these
permissions are the ones that are not about one cell's contents.

11331.name: ranges
11331.docs: Selected areas; the last one contains the active cell. Never empty.

28043.name: vml_blocks
28043.docs: The highest VML shape block a kept header and footer drawing uses: notes go after it.

11404.name: selection
11404.docs: Cell selection: one or more ranges with an active cell.

14020.name: matching_records
14020.docs: Rows (1-based within the database, excluding the header) of matching records.

7626.name: List
7626.docs: A position in a list (days, months, custom).

5083.name: draw_objects
5083.docs:
Draws charts, pictures, shapes and sparklines overlapping the body block of a page.
`pics` memoizes decoded pictures for the whole render (one page at a time draws each
picture again, but the decode happens once).

5156.name: PX_TO_PT
5156.docs: Sheet geometry is in pixels at 96 dpi; PDF units are points.

25719.name: FONT_COUNT
25719.docs: How many fonts a document can use.

5229.name: Slicer
5229.docs:
A slicer: an on-sheet filter widget bound to one column of a table. Clicking its value tiles
sets that column's `FilterCriterion::Values` in the sheet's [`AutoFilter`] and re-applies it,
so a slicer is just a visual front-end over the existing filter machinery.

25792.name: stroke_width
25792.docs: A stroke width: negative, NaN and infinite become 0 (the thinnest line).

2759.name: ApproxMeasure
2759.docs: Fixed-width approximation: `0.55 × size` per character (bold 10% wider).

6610.name: kkt_point
6610.docs:
Whether the solution is a Karush-Kuhn-Tucker point of the model, from the gradients the
report computed: every row and bound holds, and each reduced gradient (the objective's
gradient less what the binding rows' multipliers explain) is near zero relative to `terms`,
the sizes of the terms it is made of, or, for a variable at a bound, points only out of that
bound in the objective's direction. A binding row whose multiplier had the wrong sign was
dropped by [`multipliers`], so the part of the gradient it would have explained remains in
the reduced gradients and the point is refused here. Every tolerance is local to the row or
variable it tests: a large right side or gradient component elsewhere in the model excuses
nothing here.

289.name: is_r1c1_token
289.docs:
Whether `name` reads as an R1C1 reference: `R`, `C`, `RC`, `R1`, `C1`, `R1C`, `RC1`, `R1C1`
in any case.

27246.name: body_text
27246.docs: The text of a text body: the runs of each paragraph, paragraphs joined with newlines.

9299.name: body
9299.docs: The shared copy of the body that runs under `prefix`.

10607.name: chart_cols
10607.docs: Grid columns of item (not total) values with their series names: a PivotChart's series.

27319.name: DUMMY_FUNCTION
27319.docs:
The function Google Sheets' XLSX export wraps formulas in when it thinks Excel lacks one of
their functions.

4286.name: snake_case_keys
4286.docs:
The style patch with camelCase keys (`numFmt`, `diagDown`, as documented) renamed to the
style's own snake_case (`num_fmt`, `diag_down`). Keys starting with a capital (`Rgb`) stay.

30008.name: col_field
30008.docs: A column field (ColRelU / ColRelNegU): the 14-bit column and the two relative flags.

5667.name: ident
5667.docs:
Per input row: the column that started as its unit column, and whether the row was
negated to make its right side non-negative.

22379.name: DEFAULT_COL_WIDTH
22379.docs: Default width of a column and height of a row (pixels at 96 dpi) for the default font.

12134.name: store_view
12134.docs:
Records the view state that is saved with the file (`sheetView topLeftCell`, the active
cell): the first visible cell of the scrolling area per sheet index in `tops`, and the
active sheet's active cell. View state never makes the workbook dirty.

9591.name: Begun
9591.docs: A macro that passed its checks and is about to run.

654.name: get_broadcast
654.docs:
Excel's broadcasting read: a 1-row or 1-column array repeats along that axis; outside the
array is `#N/A`.

28919.name: file_formula
28919.docs:
The formula a Python cell is saved as: `_xlfn._xlws.PY(index,0|1)`, its code being script
`index` of the part ([`write`]).

26376.name: trendline_xml
26376.docs:
`<c:trendline>` with children in schema order: name, spPr, trendlineType, order, period,
forward, backward, intercept, dispRSqr, dispEq, trendlineLbl.

28992.name: unique
28992.docs: A valid name for the i-th sheet, unique among the names assigned so far, which it joins.

11045.name: dates
11045.docs: Numeric with a date number format.

14896.name: series
14896.docs:
Builds the series: pairs values with time stamps, sorts, aggregates duplicates, checks the
step and completes missing points.

26449.name: write_chartex
26449.docs:
Chartex part XML for a model chart on sheet `si`. The references it uses are appended to
`names` (see [`NAME_PREFIX`]).

12426.name: unhide_window
12426.docs: View › Unhide: shows a hidden window and activates it.

946.name: cell_format_code
946.docs: CELL("format") code for a number format.

12499.name: active_sheet
12499.docs: Convenience: the active workbook's active sheet.

17658.name: hf_page
17658.docs: The pair used by page `number` (1-based, as `&P` prints it); `first` is the sheet's first page.

3562.name: labels
3562.docs: Writes a row of labels starting at column `c`.

7413.name: auto_row_height
7413.docs:
Recomputes an automatic row height from its content: the largest font, and wrapped text.
Rows with a user-set height keep it.

Line breaks in a cell's text count only when the cell wraps, as in Excel: with Wrap Text off
a multi-line value shows on one line and AutoFit gives a one-line row.

29284.name: password_attrs
29284.docs:
A protection password hash as attributes, each name preceded by `prefix` (see
[`crate::xlsx::sheet_read::read_password`]).

28049.name: claim
28049.docs:
A part name for a kept part: its original name when that can't collide with anything
written, otherwise a fresh one in the same folder.

21655.name: rels
21655.docs: The part's own relationships, ids unchanged (the part's bytes refer to them).

3781.name: write_report
3781.docs:
Writes the report at `output` (refusing to overwrite data unless `overwrite`) or on a new
sheet.

5089.name: MAX_WRAP_LINES
5089.docs: Most lines [`wrap_lines`] returns (it may return one more, the rest of a paragraph).

1311.name: round
1311.docs:
`n` as the format of `c` on sheet `sheet` displays it (the cell's own style, else its
row's, else its column's, as the grid shows it).

16715.name: guarded
16715.docs: Runs `f` so that a panic inside it becomes an error.

24417.name: apply_name_call_case
24417.docs:
[`Workbook::name_call_case`] for every cell formula and defined name (after reading a
file).

10321.name: distinct_labels
10321.docs: Distinct item labels of a source column, sorted like the field list shows them.

3927.name: guess_header
3927.docs: Excel's header guess: the first row is text over a column of numbers, or is bold.

29576.name: add_uri
29576.docs: Adds a Microsoft extension relationship with its complete namespace URI.

16788.name: new
16788.docs:
Parses `text` (with or without `=`). Unparseable formulas keep their text and evaluate to
`#NAME?`.

1457.name: WIDE
1457.docs: Ranges wider than this many columns go to the per-sheet wide index instead of per-column ones.

29722.name: person_guid
29722.docs:
Id of the i-th person of `xl/persons/person.xml`: a GUID-shaped, deterministic id (the
file only needs ids that are unique within it).

295.name: split_areas
295.docs:
The areas of a reference list, split at the commas between them. A comma inside a quoted
sheet name (`'Sales, West'!A1`) is part of the name, and a doubled quote inside the quotes
(`'O''Brien, Jr'!A1`) is an escaped quote, not the end of the name: a quote toggles the
quoted state, so a doubled one toggles it twice.

25944.name: image_rgba
25944.docs:
Draws an RGBA image (`pw`×`ph` pixels, row-major, straight alpha) into the box
`(x, y, w, h)`. Malformed or oversized buffers are ignored.

31176.name: delimiter
31176.docs: Field separator; `0` auto-detects comma, semicolon or tab.

11994.name: FromFile
11994.docs:
Opened from a file, or holding content pasted from one: active content asks before it
runs.

4365.name: scatter_x_from_first
4365.docs:
A scatter plot of a block without category labels takes its first column (or row) as the X
values of the others, as Excel does: two plain columns make one series of points, not two (#428).

30014.name: pop
30014.docs: Pops an operand, recording its depth in `kids` (the deepest operand this token consumed).

3130.name: Counts
3130.docs: How often each displayed text occurs (duplicate / unique values).

4438.name: save_recording
4438.docs: Saves the recording into the workbook at index `at`.

30160.name: MAX_FONTS
30160.docs: Font records kept at most ([MS-XLS] FontIndex allows indexes up to 1022).

733.name: to_text
733.docs: Coercion to text as `&` does it.

23839.name: EQUATION_BUDGET_MESSAGE
23839.docs: Why an equation past [`MAX_EQUATION_LAYOUT_BYTES`] has no layout.

const.expr: "This workbook has more equations than are laid out at once; edit this equation to lay it out."

14902.name: after_last
14902.docs: The time stamp `k` steps after the last one.

806.name: trim_decimal
806.docs: Removes trailing zeros (and a trailing point) from a decimal string.

9816.name: on_cells
9816.docs: The point lies on cells (inside a page's margins, on a cell of that page).

12432.name: execute_headless
12432.docs:
Runs a command for a caller with no UI (MCP, CLI): queued UI requests are dropped, and a command that only
queued a file dialog because it got no file (`file.open`, `file.saveAs`, `file.save` on a workbook with no
file yet, `data.getData`) is an error instead of a silent success.

7346.name: target_sheet
7346.docs: The sheet a call names (`sheet` param or a `Sheet!` prefix on `range`), else the active one.

11197.name: recent
11197.docs:
Formulas › Recently Used: the functions most recently entered in a formula.

The list is [`crate::engine::Prefs::recent_functions`], an application list like Excel's, saved with
the other preferences. [`crate::engine::Session::execute`] calls [`note`] for each `cell.*` and
`range.*` command it journals, from any source (the interface, the control channel, MCP or a
script), so the list never depends on the journal, which drops its oldest entries.

12505.name: Anchor
12505.docs: One end of a reference, with `$` anchors.

7419.name: text_needs_quote_prefix
7419.docs:
Whether typing `t` back into a General cell would not give the text `t` again (it would parse
as a number, boolean, error, date or formula, or lose a leading apostrophe). Such text is shown
for editing with a leading `'`, as Excel does for text carrying a quote prefix, so that
committing the editor unchanged keeps the cell as text.

4949.name: HfPage
4949.docs: Which header/footer pair a printed page uses.

16502.name: color
16502.docs: An explicit colour (`\color`); `None` is the equation's own ("Automatic") colour.

25512.name: too_long
25512.docs: True when `code` is longer than [`MAX_FORMAT_CODE_CHARS`] characters.

1171.name: function_by_name
1171.docs:
A worksheet function given by name where a function is expected (`BYROW(A1:C3,SUM)`,
`GROUPBY(A2:A9,B2:B9,SUM)`): its name, unless a LET/LAMBDA variable or a defined name has
that name.

3787.name: FormControl
3787.docs: A form control (button, slider, spin button) floating over the sheet.

25585.name: Rect
25585.docs: A page-space rectangle described by its top-left corner and extent.

7638.name: dates
7638.docs:
The pattern of Fill Days, Fill Weekdays, Fill Months or Fill Years, or `None` when the
source isn't all dates (numbers, not formulas, under a date format in its first cell).

5095.name: StyleTable
5095.docs: Interned styles. Index 0 is the default (Normal) style.

9.name: offset
9.docs: Moved by `(dr, dc)`, `None` when the result leaves the sheet.

11562.name: Target
11562.docs: Which window a command from a script or agent acts on.

21880.name: FILE_PREFIX
21880.docs: The prefix files put before `PY(`, as Excel writes it ([MS-XLSX]: `_xlfn._xlws.PY`).

15486.name: roman_tokens
15486.docs:
Tokens (text, value) for a ROMAN form, largest value first. Form 0 is classic; each higher
form widens one of two limits on the subtracted numeral's ratio to the larger one, alternating:
the limit for I/X/C (10, 10, 100, 100, 1000) and for V/L (none, 20, 20, 200, 200). So form 2
allows IC and XM but not VD, and form 3 adds VD and VM but not ID.

5241.name: Rng
5241.docs: A small deterministic generator (SplitMix64), so a seed reproduces a run on every platform.

6549.name: MULTIPLIER_WORK
6549.docs:
Most arithmetic the Lagrange multipliers of a nonlinear model may take (about a second): a
pass over k binding rows and f free variables costs about 3·k²·f (the normal equations and
each multiplier's noise), and each pass drops at most one row, so a model at the constraint
limit could otherwise take minutes.

1463.name: max_end
1463.docs:
Segment tree over `items`: node `i` has children `2i` and `2i + 1`, leaves start at
`max_end.len() / 2`. Each node holds the largest end below it (dead entries included).

4079.name: DEFAULT_SIZE_PT
4079.docs: Default equation font size, in points.

25877.name: rect
25877.docs: PDF coordinates, with the origin at the bottom left.

29728.name: workbook_view_attrs
29728.docs:
The `<workbookView>` attributes beyond `activeTab`: the window's display settings
that differ from the format's defaults. An ordinary workbook gets none, so its file
is unchanged; a workbook Excel saved with the sheet tabs or scroll bars hidden
keeps them that way (#3057).

4152.name: keep_watch_list
4152.docs:
The Watch Window list isn't an edit (Excel doesn't undo it): undo and redo keep the current
list when they swap in another snapshot of the workbook.

2990.name: CfLook
2990.docs: The conditional look of one cell.

6841.name: set_many
6841.docs:
Stores every `(key, text)` of `items` as [`set`] would, with the checks done before anything
changes and one pass over the names for all of them, so writing a thousand items into a
workbook with many thousands of names stays near-linear.

4298.name: adjust_decimals
4298.docs: Adds or removes one decimal place in the number format (Increase/Decrease Decimal).

14616.name: MAX_POINTS
14616.docs: Longest timeline (after completing missing points) the functions accept.

22318.name: is_row_filtered
22318.docs:
Whether `row` is hidden by an applied filter: a hidden row below the header of the
sheet AutoFilter while it has criteria, or a hidden data row of a filtered table.
Other hidden rows were hidden by hand.

19848.name: ShapeFormat
19848.docs:
How a shape's outline and text look. The text properties apply to the whole text (the first
paragraph's and first run's properties when a file has several).

5752.name: pivot
5752.docs: Pivots the tableau on (r, j), updating the objective row.

3282.name: num
3282.docs: A coordinate with two decimals; a non-finite value is 0 so the SVG stays well-formed.

25153.name: scaled
25153.docs: The number a section works on: each `%` multiplies by 100, each scaling comma divides by 1000.

26461.name: cell_at
26461.docs: The cell under a sheet position and the offset into it: (cell, dx, dy).

2120.name: level_groups
2120.docs:
Groups of an outer category level: `(first, end)` index pairs, a group starting at every
non-empty entry (and at the first category).

9822.name: extent
9822.docs: Width / height of everything laid out so far.

3428.name: tag_end
3428.docs:
Byte index of the `>` that closes the tag `rest` starts with; a `>` inside a quoted attribute
value (an inline `mso-number-format` condition such as `[>=1000]`) doesn't end it.

20140.name: link
20140.docs:
The linked cell as reference text: `$B$2` on the control's own sheet, or `Sheet2!$B$2`.
Structural edits rewrite it like a formula reference.

27842.name: sheet
27842.docs:
Sheet-level content of the sheet part `part`. `controls` says which form controls the
sheet reader modelled (their VML shapes are left out of the kept content) and whether the
VML drawing holds others that only it lists.

3501.name: variables
3501.docs:
Splits a range into variables (columns, or rows when `by_rows`); with `labels` the first
cell of each names it, else `default(i)` does.

11203.name: push
11203.docs: Moves `names` (most recent first) to the front of `recent`, keeping at most [`MAX`].

958.name: Expr
958.docs:
A formula's syntax tree.

A flat operator chain such as `=A1+A2+…` nests one [`Expr::Binary`] per operator on its
left, so a formula as long as Excel allows (8,192 characters) is about 4,000 levels deep.
`Clone`, `PartialEq`, [`Expr::walk`] and [`Expr::map`] therefore follow that left spine in a
loop and recurse only into right-hand operands and real nesting, which the parser bounds.

7425.name: range_text
7425.docs: Tab-separated text of a range, as the system clipboard gets it.

12584.name: MoveToSheet
12584.docs: Cut-paste to another sheet; fully contained references follow the destination sheet too.

27988.name: local_name
27988.docs: The local name of the tag whose text starts at `name` (`x:controls` → `controls`).

21594.name: iterated
21594.docs: H0 = H(salt + UTF-16LE password); Hn = H(Hn-1 + n as 32-bit little-endian), `spin` times.

29296.name: cf_rule_xml
29296.docs:
One `cfRule` element. The formulas generated for text, blank, error and date rules refer to the
top-left cell of all the rule's areas, the cell Excel reads relative references from.

26753.name: block_size
26753.docs: The bytes the algorithm's compression function takes: 128 for SHA-384/512, else 64.

8879.name: is_ref_key
8879.docs: Whether a parameter called `key` holds a reference.

3793.name: new_anchor
3793.docs: The anchor of a new control: `at` or `cell` (default the active cell), with its size.

8952.name: base
8952.docs: The base of a token and whether it has a header row.

17962.name: custom
17962.docs: The size was set by the user (rows): automatic heights follow the content.

29515.name: builtin_id
29515.docs:
Id to write for a format code when it is a locale-independent built-in. The currency formats
5–8 and the accounting formats with a currency, 42 and 44, are written as custom formats because
their meaning depends on the reader's locale.

15419.name: value_args
15419.docs:
Parameter positions that take a single value and reject a reference to more than one
cell with `#VALUE!` (the Analysis ToolPak functions: EOMONTH, WORKDAY, COUPDAYS, BIN2DEC…),
where other scalar parameters lift the range. Arrays that aren't references still lift.
Same layout as `scalar_args`; filled at registration from [`lift::value_args`].

5174.name: review
5174.docs:
Review tab: protection, spelling (basic), workbook statistics, comment navigation and the
Comments pane, Show All Notes and Convert to Comments.

21886.name: PyOutput
21886.docs: A Python result kept on the cell.

3939.name: is_formula_input
3939.docs:
Whether typing `input` into a cell enters a formula: `=…`, or `+…`/`-…` followed by a name or
a parenthesis (not a number), as Excel takes `+SUM(1)`.

27045.name: decode_text
27045.docs:
Decodes CSV bytes with BOM-aware UTF-8 and UTF-16 handling. Without a BOM, valid UTF-8 is kept.
Other bytes decode as Windows-1256 when they read as Arabic (see [`Cp1256Evidence`]), else as
Windows-1252.

18108.name: totals_label
18108.docs: Totals row label (first column) or custom formula.

30969.name: rich_text
30969.docs:
Text of a SpreadsheetML string item (`<si>`, `<is>`, comment `<text>`): `<t>` and rich text
runs `<r><t>`, phonetic runs ignored (read them with [`phonetic_data`] instead — they are hints,
not part of the text). Decodes `_xHHHH_` escapes.

4085.name: frame_for
4085.docs: The frame size for `list` at `scale` pixels per em.

29734.name: formula
29734.docs:
BIFF8 parsed formulas ([MS-XLS] 2.2.2, 2.5.198): reverse-Polish `Ptg` tokens back to an
expression tree. Anything outside the common token set is reported as unsupported, and the
caller keeps the cell's cached value instead.

4158.name: window_param
4158.docs:
The window a window command names: `window` (an id), else `doc` (a workbook id: its most
recent window), else the active window.

5539.name: Solved
5539.docs: x, objective to minimise, and whether the solver converged (vs. ran out of budget).

27337.name: has_mimetype
27337.docs:
Reads only the small, exact mimetype entry, including when the ZIP uses compression.
Looking at a filename or at arbitrary bytes inside the archive is not sufficient.

6847.name: item_of
6847.docs:
The item a name holds a part of: a hidden workbook-scope `_gc_<key>_<k>` name, or a legacy
`_sc_<key>` one. A visible name of the `_gc_` shape is someone's own name, not an item: it is
neither read, nor listed, nor removed on write.

22324.name: merge_at
22324.docs: The merged range containing `c`, if any.

19781.name: Equation
19781.docs:
An equation: `Shape::text` holds its LaTeX source, `Shape::line` its ink colour
(`Color::Auto` for the sheet's text colour) and `Shape::math` its cached layout.

26248.name: root_entry
26248.docs:
The contents of the stream called `name` (case-insensitive) directly under the root
storage, or `None` when there is no such stream.
The directory entry of the stream called `name` (case-insensitive) directly under the
root storage.

4523.name: update
4523.docs: Applies `f` to the targeted pivot and re-renders it, as one undo step.

30172.name: Xf
30172.docs: One XF record, decoded as far as its bytes allow.

3288.name: MAX_HTML_CELLS
3288.docs:
Most cells, span placeholders included, one paste reads from the HTML. Past it the rest of the
table is ignored: the HTML only refines cells of the tab-separated text, which stays the source.

28937.name: known_function
28937.docs:
Whether GridCraft calculates a function, when the caller says: cell formulas wrapped by
Google Sheets' export are then read as the formula inside (see [`crate::xlsx::read_xlsx_with`]).

16149.name: omml
16149.docs:
LaTeX to OMML, the open Office Math Markup of ECMA-376 Part 1 §22.1, for the common subset:
runs, fractions and binomials, roots, scripts, big operators with limits, functions and
limits, delimiters, matrices, accents, bars, braces and font styles. Anything else is an
error, and the caller saves the equation as text only.

17457.name: grand_totals_cols
17457.docs: Grand total for each column (the "Grand Total" row), like Excel's "On for Columns".

25159.name: blank_range
25159.docs:
Replaces the literals in `range` with spaces (`spaces`) or nothing; placeholders and the bar
in it get the same treatment through `pieces`.

30318.name: xf_font
30318.docs: The font an XF names (FontIndex: index 4 is never written, so 5 and up count from one).

3434.name: format_for
3434.docs:
A number format that shows `n` exactly as `shown` ("Rp10,000.00" for 10000 →
`"Rp"#,##0.00`), inferred from the text around the digits. `None` unless the format renders
`shown` back character for character.

12444.name: add_document
12444.docs: Opens a workbook in a new window, which becomes the active one.

13752.name: struct_ref_file
13752.docs:
Structured reference as files spell it: `[@Col]` is only Excel's display shorthand, files
hold `[[#This Row],[Col]]` (and `[#This Row]` for `[@]`).

11209.name: RECORD_MAX_BYTES
11209.docs:
The most bytes (steps serialized as JSON) one recording keeps. A step keeps its full
parameters so it can be played back, and a `file.open` holds the whole file as base64, so
without a size cap a recording of a few opens of a large workbook keeps tens of MB alive.

27921.name: scan_sheet
27921.docs:
Finds the sheet's `<picture>`, `<oleObjects>`, `<controls>` (also inside
`<mc:AlternateContent>`) and the `<legacyDrawing>` and `<legacyDrawingHF>` ids. `None` when the XML is damaged.

21527.name: DEFAULT_SPIN_COUNT
21527.docs: Excel's default spin count for new passwords.

4888.name: HF_FIELDS
4888.docs: Header/footer codes and the field names the Page Layout view shows for them while editing.

2345.name: max_forward
2345.docs: Longest forward forecast among `s`'s regression trendlines.

13898.name: bare_empty
13898.docs: The criterion was a bare `""` (or empty cell text): matches blanks and empty strings.

25524.name: symbol
25524.docs:
The standard Symbol font: its built-in encoding and advance widths.

Source: the character codes and glyph advance widths ("C" and "WX" values) of Adobe's Core 14
AFM metrics file for Symbol (`Symbol.afm`, version 001.008), and the Unicode values of its glyph
names from Unicode, Inc.'s `symbol.txt` ("Adobe Symbol Encoding to Unicode", table version
1.0). Adobe distributes the Core 14 metrics with permission to use, copy and distribute them
for any purpose (the notice is quoted in `metrics.rs`); Unicode, Inc. grants the right to use
the information in its file in products supporting the Unicode Standard (its notice is
recorded in `ATTRIBUTION.md`). Only the numbers are reproduced here, typed in from the public
tables; neither file is included. The stretchable
bracket, brace and integral pieces (codes 0xE6 to 0xEF and 0xF3 to 0xFE) and the sans-serif
duplicates of the registered, copyright and trademark signs are left out of the Unicode map:
they have no Unicode counterpart of their own.

1183.name: index_one
1183.docs: INDEX for one row and column position (0 = the whole column or row).

8885.name: reads_as_token
8885.docs: Whether `text` would read as a token in a macro whose inputs are `inputs` (see [`is_token`]).

28140.name: WorkbookKept
28140.docs: The workbook's kept content as written.

3799.name: linked_number
3799.docs: The number the control's linked cell holds, if it holds one.

26905.name: Params
26905.docs: The cipher parameters shared by `keyData` and a password `encryptedKey` element.

14117.name: count_workdays
14117.docs: Working days in [a, b] (a ≤ b) ignoring holidays.

21819.name: package_rels
21819.docs: Relationships of the package root (`_rels/.rels`) to kept parts (workbook owner only).

29521.name: file_function_name
29521.docs: The name to write for a function (`XLOOKUP` → `_xlfn.XLOOKUP`, `FILTER` → `_xlfn._xlws.FILTER`).

15425.name: LIFTED_SCAN_BUDGET
15425.docs:
Work budget of a lifted [`SCANS`] lookup: needle cells times the length of the longest vector
it searches (the longest dimension of its largest non-lifted array). Each needle re-reads and
scans the vector (about 8 ns per entry), so without a cap a one-cell formula such as
`XMATCH(SEQUENCE(1048576), -SEQUENCE(1048576))` runs for hours and hangs opening the file.
Past the budget the call is `#NUM!`, as MMULT is past 2e9 multiply-adds. 5e8 keeps the worst
case to a few seconds and still admits 5,000 needles over a 100,000-row table.

5180.name: new_password_hash
5180.docs:
A new Excel-compatible (SHA-512, salted) hash of `pw`. The salt mixes `what` is protected
with the document, a counter and the clock, so equal passwords get different hashes.

21892.name: fits
21892.docs: Whether the code fits in a PY formula of at most [`MAX_FORMULA_CHARS`] characters.

3945.name: edit
3945.docs: Cell entry, selection, undo/redo, clipboard, clear, fill, find & replace.

27051.name: MonthFirst
27051.docs: A value reads only month first (`12/31/2026`), none reads only day first.

6561.name: At
6561.docs:
What both report bodies share: the model, the solution, its objective value and the rows'
final values and right sides.

6634.name: Solve
6634.docs: What a solve ended with, and why Simplex LP or Evolutionary stopped.

28505.name: col
28505.docs: Column offset in the source (database fields only).

1621.name: calculate
1621.docs:
Calculates `k` (and the formulas it reads) with bounded stack: when [`Self::compute`] would
go deeper than [`MAX_NESTED`], it suspends what is in progress, the formula it needed is
calculated from here, then the suspended ones again (reading the results kept so far).

4310.name: selection_totals
4310.docs: Totals for a multi-cell selection as `(cell, formula)` writes. `None` when the sheet has no data.

1767.name: components
1767.docs:
Strongly connected components of a graph given as adjacency lists (Tarjan, iterative): each
node's component index, and the number of nodes in each component.

6926.name: whatif
6926.docs:
What-If Analysis (Data › Forecast): Goal Seek, Scenario Manager, Data Tables; and the Data
Tools that work on whole lists: Advanced Filter and Consolidate.

Every what-if evaluation is a *trial*: the workbook is cloned (cheap — sheets and cell bands
are copy-on-write), the input cells are overwritten, and only their dependents are
recalculated with the document's dependency graph. The document itself only changes when a
command writes its final answer (one undo step).

4383.name: ObjRef
4383.docs: One floating object on a sheet: its kind and its workbook-unique id.

26181.name: cfb
26181.docs:
Just enough of the Compound File Binary (CFB/OLE2) container to tell what a non-zip
spreadsheet file is: Excel wraps password-protected workbooks in a CFB holding an
`EncryptedPackage` stream, while Excel 97-2003 `.xls` (and other legacy Office files) are
CFB files without one. Every read is bounds-checked and every loop bounded.

15936.name: template
15936.docs:
A replacement split into pieces as `regex::Captures::expand` reads it: `$$` is `$`, `$name` takes
the longest run of `[_0-9A-Za-z]`, `${name}` ends at `}` (`${}` is empty), a name of digits is a
group number, and a `$` that starts no reference is itself.

4456.name: insert_sheet_before_active
4456.docs:
Inserts a new, empty sheet before the active one (Excel's place for a new PivotTable or a
Show Details sheet); returns its index.

28870.name: script_code
28870.docs:
A `pythonScript` element's code (ST_Xstring), with `\n` line breaks, cut after
[`MAX_SCRIPT_CHARS`] characters. The limit is measured on the decoded code, so escapes in the
file (`_x000D_`, `_x0009_`) don't cut a script that fits; decoding is linear and reads at most
[`MAX_ENCODED_CHARS`] characters.

5837.name: linearize
5837.docs:
Linearises the model at `x0` (n + 1 evaluations) and checks it at one more point. Returns the
objective gradient and constant, and per row the gradient and constant of `lhs − rhs`.

28943.name: optional_xml
28943.docs: Reads and parses an optional part: problems other than size limits become warnings.

14847.name: detect_axis
14847.docs:
The axis of sorted, distinct time stamps: a constant step (missing points allowed) or, for
dates, a constant number of calendar months.

17463.name: calculated_fields
17463.docs: Calculated fields, usable in the Values area by name.

18771.name: dates
18771.docs:
Threaded comments: when the thread (first entry) and each reply were written, ISO 8601 as
read from the file (`dT`); empty when unknown, e.g. for comments made here.

12377.name: activation
12377.docs: Window activation counter (most recently used order).

3440.name: MAX_REGRESSORS
3440.docs: Excel's limit on regression X columns.

12450.name: grouped
12450.docs:
Runs `f` as one undo step labelled `label` on the active document: whatever commands `f`
runs, one Undo brings back the workbook as it was before. If `f` fails, every change it made
is rolled back and its error is returned. Groups nest; the outermost one makes the step.

20152.name: snap
20152.docs: `v` clamped to min..max and snapped to the nearest step from min (max stays reachable).

11215.name: id
11215.docs: The command id and its parameters, without secrets.

27927.name: strip_shapes
27927.docs:
VML without its note shapes and the shapes numbered in `drop`, each judged as the control reader judges it, from the shape's own tags and never from text elsewhere in it: a note by its client data's `ObjectType` ([`crate::xlsx::controls::is_note_data`]), its number from its `id`, else its `o:spid` ([`crate::xlsx::controls::number_of`]). Each tag is read on its own ([`xml::first_start`]), so a caption's unclosed `
` doesn't hide the client data after it. A shape with no number that isn't a note is kept.

9980.name: ValSrc
9980.docs: Where a value field's numbers come from.

2351.name: draw_trend_labels
2351.docs: Trendline equation / R² labels, stacked in the plot's top-right corner.

6202.name: cells_of
6202.docs: Cells of `"B2:B4,D1"` on one sheet (row-major per area, in order), at most `cap`.

3659.name: ols
3659.docs: Ordinary least squares of `y` on the columns `xs`, with an intercept unless `zero`.

19063.name: mode
19063.docs: How the object follows its anchor cell when rows/columns move (sort, insert, delete).

1189.name: value
1189.docs: Evaluates to a value (references are dereferenced; multi-cell → array).

29527.name: SPIN_COUNT
29527.docs: The spin count `encrypt_workbook` uses: Excel's default.

29673.name: vmls
29673.docs: VML drawings written, the last VML shape-id block used, and control properties parts.

5332.name: Stalled
5332.docs: The best member didn't improve for the set number of generations.

4097.name: Page
4097.docs: A page under construction. Obtain one with [`PdfDoc::add_page`].

27203.name: valid_date
27203.docs: The serial for a date the input parser accepts, or `None`.

4170.name: stash_get
4170.docs: Workbook-level JSON stored in a hidden defined name (round-trips through XLSX).

8021.name: open_bytes_with_password
8021.docs:
[`open_bytes`], first decrypting a password-protected workbook with `password`. Errors never
quote the password.

6786.name: Listing
6786.docs: What a listing found: the first [`MAX_ITEMS`] items or keys, and how many more there were.

9402.name: SheetFootprint
9402.docs: The cells a macro would write on one sheet, outside its inputs.

13253.name: map
13253.docs: Rewrites every node bottom-up, children left to right before their parent.

6859.name: show_objects
6859.docs: Ctrl+6: hides every object, or shows them again. Placeholders (from a file) count as shown.

15869.name: THAI_PLACES
15869.docs: Units, tens, hundreds, thousands, ten thousands, hundred thousands.

4389.name: set_anchor_mode
4389.docs:
Sets an object's anchor mode (Excel's "Move and size with cells" / "Move but don't size with
cells" / "Don't move or size with cells"), so it follows — or ignores — its rows and columns
when the sheet is sorted or edited structurally.

15942.name: MAX_CELLS
15942.docs: Largest array a function may build.

4462.name: PivotTable
4462.docs:
A PivotTable: its definition plus where its output was last written. The output itself is
static cell values and styles on the sheet, rewritten on every refresh.

28876.name: PyFormula
28876.docs: What a file formula is to Python.

27641.name: parse_date
27641.docs:
Support unzoned ISO calendar dates and times. A timezone, invalid date or out-of-range
calendar year remains text; never silently discard an offset or roll an invalid date.

830.name: base
830.docs:
GridCraft core types: cell addresses, values and Excel's coercion rules, error values,
date serials and typed-input parsing. No dependencies on the rest of the workspace.

3446.name: OVERWRITE_ERROR
3446.docs:
Part of the error a programmatic call gets when the output range already holds data; the
dialog recognises it and asks before running again with `overwrite: true`.

12456.name: group_is_open
12456.docs: Whether the token's undo group is still open (nothing has ended or rolled it back).

27933.name: attr_value
27933.docs:
The value of the first attribute `name` in XML text `x`, in either quote style (`name="v"` or
`name='v'`), when it has one. The name must start a token (`id` is not the end of `spid`).

9986.name: filter_sets
9986.docs: Each filter's selected labels, ASCII-lowercased, so a record's test is one probe.

29241.name: dynamic_range
29241.docs:
The known dynamic range `pos` lies in, when it isn't the range's anchor: the cell's cached
value gives way to the formula that will fill it (or, for a Python cell, becomes its
result). Charges every scanned range against one work budget, then gives up consulting the
ranges at all: the worst kind of file may then import a few cached spill values, but it
never stalls the whole import.

18996.name: MoveOnly
18996.docs: Move but don't size with cells (`<xdr:twoCellAnchor editAs="oneCell">` / `<xdr:oneCellAnchor>`).

26698.name: check_encryption
26698.docs:
Whether the right password could decrypt this encrypted workbook, checked without one. An
error names a scheme no password opens (RC4, rights management…) or damage, so callers can
say so instead of asking for a password first.

6208.name: sensitivity_status
6208.docs:
Whether a `data.solver` result status is a solution the Sensitivity report can describe: an
optimum (Simplex LP) or a converged local optimum (GRG Nonlinear). A run that stopped at its
evaluation limit, or an Evolutionary run, has none.

2430.name: resolve
2430.docs: Pulls chart data (names, categories, values, formats, colours) out of a workbook.

3738.name: point

15291.name: frac
15291.docs: DSC / NL of the quasi-period holding settlement.

8897.name: sub

3811.name: take_requests
3811.docs:
Drops the UI requests a button's command queued from `queued` on, keeping messages for the

buttons don't do (`name` is the button's). A cell edit the command asked for is dropped too.

29460.name: read_styles

`checkboxes`: for each `xfComplement` index, whether it is a checkbox (see
[`crate::xlsx::feature_bags::checkbox_complements`]); empty when the file has no feature property bags.

28225.name: workbook_elements
28225.docs: The workbook's kept elements of `slot` that refer to no part (`fileVersion`, `ext`).

14129.name: arr_arg
14129.docs: Argument `i` as an owned array; error values propagate.

29533.name: HMAC_KEY
29533.docs:
The dataIntegrity HMAC key, as long as the hash: Excel writes 64 bytes for SHA-512, not the
salt-size key [MS-OFFCRYPTO] 2.3.4.14 describes.

15437.name: vector
15437.docs: A 1-D view of an array (row or column), `None` when it is 2-D.

26990.name: base64
26990.docs: Standard base64 (whitespace ignored), as Agile's XML uses for every binary value.

11659.name: is_window_command
11659.docs: Commands that take `window`/`doc` as their own parameters rather than as a target.

15583.name: special
15583.docs:
Numeric special functions: gamma, error function, incomplete gamma and beta, the normal
distribution and a generic monotone root finder. Written from the standard textbook
formulations (Lanczos approximation, series / continued-fraction expansions).

24593.name: decimal_digits
24593.docs:
The 15 significant digits of a positive finite number and the power of ten of the first
digit: `a ≈ d0.d1d2… × 10^exp`.

The value is rounded to the nearest 15-digit decimal. An exact tie at the 16th digit (the exact
decimal expansion is 15 digits, a 5, then only zeros, as for 1234567890123455 or
123456789012345.5) goes toward zero, as Excel does: `1234567890123455` shows `1234567890123450`,
not `…460`. Excel observed (Windows 16.0.20430, TEXT()).

7954.name: io
7954.docs: Opening and saving files: XLSX, legacy XLS import, XLSB and ODS data import, SYLK import, CSV/TSV, JSON (debug), HTML export.

15656.name: t_inv_upper
15656.docs: t ≥ 0 with P(T > t) = q, q in (0, 0.5].

16964.name: Compact
16964.docs: All row fields in one column, inner items indented ("Row Labels" header).

20815.name: MAX_MACRO_REF
20815.docs:
The longest reference or token in a macro (an output anchor, an input's default range, a
Repeat's range, an If's cell), in characters.

6719.name: spelling
6719.docs:
Spelling: checks text cells against the system word list (`/usr/share/dict/words` on macOS
and Linux; nothing is bundled) plus a user dictionary kept in the engine preferences.

8027.name: adopt_python
8027.docs:
Python cells from a file: a cell whose formula is `PY("…",0|1)` (a format that kept it as a
formula) becomes a Python cell, and a Python cell whose spilled values the file cached gets
them back as its result, so it shows them until it runs again. Results are rebuilt for at most
[`MAX_ADOPTED_RESULT_CELLS`] cells in all; the rest keep only their own cached value, and the
values they spilled stay as plain values. Returns the warnings.

20888.name: macros
20888.docs:
GridCraft macros: typed, declarative command lists that run as one undo step. They are not VBA:
a VBA project in a file is carried through unchanged (`Workbook::vba_project`) and never run.

22196.name: SheetUid
22196.docs:
A sheet's identity while the app runs, for what must follow one sheet (an open cell draft): a
sheet made new (added, inserted, copied, read from a file or from JSON) gets a fresh one, and it
stays with the sheet through renames, moves and the copies undo keeps. Never saved.
It is not content: any two compare equal, so comparing sheets compares what they hold; compare
identities with [`SheetUid::get`].

11951.name: trust
11951.docs: Trust of the source document: pasting content from a file someone else made carries it.

9408.name: partial
9408.docs: The dry run stopped early before this step; later steps aren't in the footprint.

4322.name: stash
4322.docs:
GridCraft data kept in hidden workbook-scope defined names, so that it travels inside the xlsx
file.

An item `key` is stored as names `_gc_<key>_0`, `_gc_<key>_1`, …, each a formula of string
literals joined with `&`: `"…"&"…"`. Excel limits a string literal to 255 characters and a
formula to 8,192, so a long value is split over as many names as it needs and the file stays
one that Excel accepts. Older items (custom views, scripts, the watch list and scenarios) keep
one name each, `_sc_<key>`; reading accepts that form as well, so those items can move to this
format later, and a write of the same key replaces it.

XML can't carry every character (controls other than tab, line feed and carriage return, and
U+FFFE and U+FFFF), and the xlsx writer drops those. In `_gc_` items each of them, and the
marker itself, is written as [`ESCAPE`] followed by its code as four upper-case hex digits
(`U+0001` becomes `\u{FDD0}0001`), and reading turns them back. The marker is a Unicode
noncharacter, which XML carries but real text does not use, so the escape costs nothing on
ordinary text. Legacy `_sc_` items are read as they are.

15875.name: fold
15875.docs: Lower-cased char sequence with one char per input char (keeps positions aligned).

544.name: parse_number_text
544.docs: Numeric text as arithmetic coerces it ("1,000", "50%", "$3", "1/2/2020", "10:00").

4395.name: links_outside

Sorts a link target as the two pages of Excel's Insert Hyperlink dialog do: "Place in This
Document" is a sheet reference, a defined name or `#…`; anything else ("Existing File or Web
Page") is outside the workbook and saved as a relationship.

26193.name: MAX_STREAM
26193.docs: Streams larger than this are refused (the format allows more, a workbook never needs it).

4468.name: take_from_axes
4468.docs: Takes `field` out of Rows and Columns (Σ Values keeps its place); returns its first entry.

8319.name: MAX_BREAKPOINTS
8319.docs: The most breakpoints one call sets.

9627.name: begin
9627.docs:
The checks before a run, on the active workbook: the macro exists, the policy allows it, the
person approved it if it needs that, and its inputs are right.

27647.name: MAX_OUT_BYTES
27647.docs:
Longest LaTeX the conversion produces before it gives up. `crate::math::check` refuses a
longer source anyway, so converting the rest of a wide or long equation would only spend time
and memory on a hostile file.

9773.name: summary_before
9773.docs: Whether the sheet's summary rows (`rows`) or summary columns sit before their detail.

30336.name: ENCRYPTED
30336.docs: The message for an encrypted workbook (a FilePass record).

12389.name: recording
12389.docs: Journal position where Automate › Record Actions started.

11154.name: error
11154.docs: The compile error of a calculated field, if any.

22707.name: colors
22707.docs: lt1, dk1, lt2, dk2, accent1..6, hlink, folHlink (0xRRGGBB).

8611.name: Script
8611.docs: A step of a recorded script run: plain parameters, kept as they are.

9919.name: links_to
9919.docs: Whether a PivotChart link points at `pivot` on `sheet`.

4833.name: make_block
4833.docs: Builds a block for rows × cols positioned at (x, y) on the page.

26631.name: PASSWORD_ENCRYPTOR
26631.docs: The password key encryptor's URI (the other kind is certificate-based).

2290.name: draw_runs
2290.docs:
Draws a polyline split at gaps (`None`), decimated when long. With `smooth` (the plot box),
each run is interpolated with a Catmull-Rom spline so the line curves through the data points.

29247.name: MAX_HYPERLINK_CELLS
29247.docs: Most cells one sheet's hyperlinks may cover (each cell gets its own copy of the link).

15151.name: financial
15151.docs:
Financial functions: time value of money, cash-flow analysis, depreciation and securities.

Sign convention follows Excel: money paid out is negative, money received is positive.
Date arguments are serial numbers (truncated) in the workbook's date system.

6214.name: SOLVER_KEYS
6214.docs:
The names of a saved model after `solver_`, as Excel's Solver writes them (GridCraft writes
some of them). Saving a model and Reset All remove these and no other `solver_` names.

1128.name: cell_value
1128.docs: The current value of a cell (evaluating it first if it is dirty).

2436.name: union_parts
2436.docs: The parts of a union reference `(Sheet1!$A$1:$A$3,Sheet1!$A$5)`, or `None`.

14062.name: field_numbers
14062.docs: Numbers of the field among matching records (field required).

21764.name: before
21764.docs: How many worksheets come before it: its position among the model's sheets.

3817.name: path_note
3817.docs:
The file a button's command names in its `path`, as ` (path)` for its approval question, so

is shortened in the middle.

14135.name: pad_arg
14135.docs: Pad value for WRAPROWS/EXPAND…: `#N/A` when omitted.

26996.name: arabic
26996.docs: Of those, Arabic letters and Arabic punctuation (، ؛ ؟) in Windows-1256.

30920.name: child_val
30920.docs: `val` attribute of a child (the common `<c:x val=".."/>` pattern).

4036.name: GO_TO_MAX_AREAS

7887.name: learn
7887.docs: Finds a program consistent with every example.

15589.name: reg_gamma_q
15589.docs: Regularised upper incomplete gamma Q(a, x) = 1 − P(a, x).

30993.name: num
30993.docs: Formats a number for an XML attribute/value (shortest round-trip form).

24599.name: format_general_fit
24599.docs:
General format squeezed into `max_chars` characters. Excel shows fewer decimals, then
scientific notation, then "####" when a column is narrow; `None` means the caller paints "####".

4109.name: recently_used
4109.docs:
Formulas › Recently Used: the functions most recently entered in a formula, newest first
([`crate::engine::Prefs::recent_functions`]).

2874.name: smooth
2874.docs: Draw line segments as a smoothed (spline) curve.

4182.name: close
4182.docs: File › Close closes the active window; the workbook closes with its last window.

8033.name: read_plain
8033.docs: Parses bytes that aren't encrypted, as they are.

1639.name: abandoned
1639.docs: The formulas abandoned since the last suspension.

28596.name: add_sheet
28596.docs:
Writes the caches of a sheet's PivotTables and adds the sheet's relationships to its
PivotTable parts. Pivots whose source can't be resolved are not written.

4255.name: row_height
4255.docs:
Sizes are pixels at 96 dpi, the model's unit (header drags send pixels). `points` (row height)
and `chars` (column width) take Excel's units, those of its Row Height and Column Width dialogs
and of the file (`ht` is in points).

8106.name: is_right_to_left_letter
8106.docs: Hebrew, Arabic, Syriac, Thaana, N'Ko and their presentation forms.

19659.name: hole_size
19659.docs:
Doughnut hole size as a percentage of the plot radius (Excel's 10–90 range). New charts and
XLSX imports use Excel's 75; a document saved before this field existed reads as 50.

1712.name: Calc
1712.docs: Calculation state kept beside a workbook.

4328.name: pasteable_names
4328.docs:
The names Paste Names lists, as (name, refers-to text with `=`): the workbook's names and the
active sheet's own, without hidden names, in alphabetical order. A sheet's name hides the
workbook name it shares.

1785.name: MAX_ABS
1785.docs: Largest magnitude we plot; bigger values are clamped so ranges stay finite.

28742.name: MAX_ITEMS
28742.docs: Most shared items kept per field (Excel's limit is 1,048,576 unique items).

550.name: parenthesized
550.docs:
The number inside accounting parentheses, as plain text: `(5)` gives `5`. A dollar sign may
stand before them (`$(5)` reads as `($5)`) and a percent sign after them (`(5)%` reads as
`(5%)`), with spaces around either. The caller reads only a plain number or a fraction from it.

15954.name: int
15954.docs: Integer coercion (truncates toward zero). Values beyond ±2^53 give `#NUM!`.

4474.name: PivotCalcField
4474.docs:
A calculated field: a formula over other fields (`=Sales*0.1`, `='Unit Price'*Units`). As in
Excel, it is evaluated on the sums of the fields it names for each report cell, not per record.

30123.name: rich_string

9633.name: conflict_rule
9633.docs:
The conflict rule for this run: `onConflict`, else the macro's own. `overwrite: true` is the
answer to the question, so it turns `ask` into `overwrite` whichever way `ask` was given.

3239.name: chart_svg
3239.docs: Charts as inline SVG for Save as Web Page: the chart crate's drawing primitives, text included.

22494.name: get_mut
22494.docs: Mutable access (copies the band if shared).

27653.name: PROPERTIES
27653.docs:
The property elements and the properties in them that this converter reads, so the ones
that decide what an equation says beyond its structure and text. [`body_marker`] hashes
exactly these, and [`val`] and [`on`] read only these, so the two cannot drift: a property
read here without a row in this table reads as absent, which the conversion tests show.

9706.name: shortcut_text
9706.docs: How a shortcut is stored and shown: `Ctrl+Shift+M`.

25110.name: fill_frac
25110.docs: Fraction-digit placeholders: trailing zeros show as `0`, nothing (`#`) or a space (`?`).

30269.name: xf
30269.docs: An XF record. A short record keeps the fields it has.

20024.name: Macro
20024.docs: Runs a macro of the workbook on `input`, optionally sending its output to `output`.

2077.name: Labels
2077.docs:
Category labels and, for a multi-level axis, the outer levels (nearest the labels first;
one entry per category, non-empty where a group starts).

3385.name: full
3385.docs: The row or cell budget ran out: nothing more is read.

8544.name: policy
8544.docs:
What a macro step may run. Macros run commands, so this keeps a macro from saving, opening or
closing files, driving the app, running other macros, or reading and writing files without the
person knowing. It goes by command id and the `path` parameter; the runner also runs every
step except an approved file step inside the scripts' file sandbox, so a command that touches a
file under another parameter can't either.

12395.name: macro_debug

22713.name: minor_font_cs
22713.docs: The body font's complex-script typeface (`<a:cs>`); empty when the file did not set one.

26564.name: all_text

The text inside `e` and its descendants (a VML text box holds `
` and ``), up to a caption's length; `
` is a line break.

9925.name: rebind_charts
9925.docs: Rebuilds the series of every PivotChart of a PivotTable after its report was written.

26637.name: Unsupported
26637.docs: The scheme, e.g. "RC4" or "Extensible", to complete "uses {0} encryption".

2296.name: table
2296.docs: The chart data table uses the same primitives as the plot, including in print/PDF output.

29253.name: MAX_DYNAMIC_CELLS
29253.docs:
Worst-case cells inside the dynamic ranges the sheet declares. Beyond it further ranges are
dropped: they would cost their storage in every membership lookup that follows.

2369.name: MAX_LABELS
2369.docs: Data labels are skipped when a series has more points than this.

3677.name: column
3677.docs: The values of column `j` of a table of numbers.

1134.name: used_range
