The sheet's used range (`Sheet::used_range`, which walks every stored row). Hosts that
keep the workbook unchanged while evaluating can remember it.

11452.name: table_cell_style
11452.docs: The style a table gives a cell (merged over the cell's own style: explicit fills/fonts win).

2515.name: Trendline
2515.docs: A chart trendline (Add Chart Element ▸ Trendline, Format Trendline pane).

3823.name: load_action_names
3823.docs:
After a file is opened: gives buttons back the actions kept in the hidden name, and removes
it. Entries that don't parse, or don't match a button, are dropped: an entry must carry the
button's name and anchor cell, the button at the stored place must have that name and anchor
cell (another application may have added, removed or reordered controls), and it must not
have been given another macro since (a stored macro action comes back only on a button that
still runs that macro, a stored command only on one the file gives no macro). A stored fixed
input for a macro that takes no inputs becomes the selection (see [`takes_no_inputs`]).

29472.name: NumFmts
29472.docs: Number format ids assigned while writing.

6439.name: Lines
6439.docs: A report's cells: (row, column, value, bold).

3896.name: sorted_anchor
3896.docs:
Re-anchor one floating object for a sort. `bottom` is the object's bottom-right line and the
offset of that corner inside it, measured before the sort. `map` (via `dst_of`) translates a
line index on the moving axis and is the identity outside `b0..=b1`. `sh` is the post-sort
grid (row heights already reordered), so re-fitting uses the heights the object lands on.
Objects pinned absolutely ("Don't move or size with cells") never move; "move but don't size"
keeps its size; "move and size" is re-fitted when its whole extent stays inside the body, and
keeps its size when the sort turns its lines around (its bottom line now sorts before its top
line), since the lines then enclose nothing to stretch it between.

29545.name: encrypt_agile
29545.docs:
`EncryptionInfo` and `EncryptedPackage` for `plain`, Agile (AES-256, SHA-512), with the
dataIntegrity HMAC over the whole EncryptedPackage stream as Excel writes it.

5204.name: AnchorMode
5204.docs:
How a floating object is pinned to the grid when its cells move or resize. Mirrors Excel's
Format ▸ Size and Properties ▸ Properties, stored in the file as the anchor's `editAs`:
`twoCell` (absent `editAs`), `oneCell` and `absolute`.

4042.name: name_areas
4042.docs:
The sheet and areas defined name `n` refers to, seen from sheet `sheet`, when that is a
reference.

7893.name: split_fields
7893.docs: A record's fields: `;` separates them and `;;` is a literal semicolon.

16903.name: is_blank
16903.docs: No value, no formula, no Python code and the default style: storing it is pointless.

22062.name: literal
22062.docs:
`text` as a plain literal that was delimited by `quote`: its delimiter (`quote`, or the other
quote when `text` holds `quote` but not the other one, so `xl('Sheet2!B2')` becomes
`xl("'Q4 2026'!B2")` on a rename) and its contents, with backslashes escaped, and the
delimiter too when `text` holds both quotes. `None` for a line break, which no literal on
one line holds.

20827.name: permissions
20827.docs: Commands that need permission (reading or writing files) which the macro may run.

8039.name: set_first_sheet_name
8039.docs:
Names the first sheet `name`, without the characters a sheet name can't hold and cut to 31
characters; an empty or reserved result keeps the default name.

1645.name: members
1645.docs: Formulas found on a circular reference (when iterating).

8112.name: ClipboardHtml
8112.docs: Enforce the budget while escaping, before HTML expansion can allocate a large string.

19665.name: pivot
19665.docs:
A PivotChart's PivotTable (`Sheet2!PivotTable1`): its series are rebuilt from the report
whenever the PivotTable is refreshed or its layout changes.

1718.name: cells_changed
1718.docs: Updates the graph for cells whose content changed and recalculates what depends on them.

20973.name: cols
20973.docs: Allowed columns, `[min, max]`; a max of 0 means no limit.

22281.name: slicers
22281.docs: On-sheet slicer widgets (filter a table column by clicking value tiles).

4334.name: first_showing
4334.docs:
The first cell of an area, row by row, that shows `error`: a stored cell or a value spilled
into the area by a dynamic array.

1791.name: frac
1791.docs: Position of `v` along the axis, 0 at `min`, 1 at `max` (clamped to a sane band).

28748.name: label
28748.docs: The pivot item label of a value (blank shows as "(blank)").

15960.name: as_array
15960.docs: The value viewed as an array (scalars become 1×1).

8331.name: only_listed
8331.docs:
Only `breakpoints` stop the run; the steps' own flags are ignored (an editor that shows
its own breakpoints sends them all, so clearing one takes effect at once).

9639.name: check
9639.docs:
Every check a macro must pass before it is kept in a workbook: the model's limits
([`Macro::check_limits`]) and the size an xlsx file can hold. Every path that adds a macro,
from JSON, from a file or built in code, goes through this one check.

14798.name: Axis
14798.docs: How timeline values map to point positions (0 = first point).

27659.name: val
27659.docs: The `val` of property `name` in the property element `props`, when the converter reads it.

25116.name: NumberLayout
25116.docs:
Where a number section's placeholders are: the decimal point, the exponent, and the digit
placeholders before the point (or exponent) and between the point and the exponent.

9785.name: gap
9785.docs: Gap between pages in layout units.

3391.name: col
3391.docs: The column the next cell of the current row lands in.

const.expr: "The PivotTable field name is not valid. To create a PivotTable, you must use data that is organized as a list with labeled columns."

4699.name: Block
4699.docs: Everything needed to draw one page block (a run of rows × a run of columns).

8550.name: macro_policy
8550.docs:
The policy for running command `id` with `params` as a macro step in a document with `trust`.

Any `path` other than `null` counts as touching a file: a token such as `{"$ref": "Input"}`
becomes a path when the step runs, and exports write to `""` and `" "` as file names. The
runner checks the parameters both as written and as resolved.

12401.name: show_all_notes
12401.docs:
Review › Notes › Show All Notes: every note is displayed. An application display setting
(like Excel's comment indicator option), so it's not saved in the file.

29113.name: read_validation
29113.docs: A `dataValidation` (main namespace, or x14 with `xm:f` formulas and an `xm:sqref` child).

26570.name: number_of
26570.docs:
A VML shape's number: from its `id` (`_x0000_s1025`), else from `o:spid`, where producers that
give the shape a named id (`id="Button 1"`) keep it.

9931.name: check_current
9931.docs:
An error when the report on the sheet is not what `out` computes. Excel reads its PivotTable
cache; without one, the report written by the last refresh must still be what the source gives.

13782.name: fold_name
13782.docs: The case-folded form of a name: two names are [`same_name`] when their folded forms are equal.

25408.name: text_section
25408.docs: Index of the section that applies to text, if any.

8769.name: Bad
8769.docs: Anything else (an unknown input, a malformed token).

6226.name: parse_model_formulas
6226.docs: Reads formula text written by Save Model back into `data.solver` params.

3683.name: fft
3683.docs:
Radix-2 fast Fourier transform (iterative Cooley–Tukey) in place, for a power-of-two number of
complex values (re, im). The forward transform is unscaled, X[k] = Σ x[n]·e^(−2πikn/N); the
inverse uses e^(+2πikn/N) and divides by N, so it returns the values the forward one took.

2448.name: series_plot_kind
2448.docs: The kind series `i` of `chart` is drawn as: its own kind in a combo chart, else the chart's.

7607.name: fill
7607.docs: Fills `target` (which contains `src` at one edge) from the pattern in `src`.

5064.name: print_range
5064.docs:
The range a sheet prints: its print area, else the used range grown to cover drawing
objects. `None` when there is nothing to print.

20468.name: rtl
20468.docs: Paragraphs run right to left (`a:pPr rtl`).

3829.name: custom_ok
3829.docs: Does a value pass a custom comparison (`>`, `=*abc*`, `<>x`…)?

24392.name: ActiveSheet
24392.docs:
The active sheet index of a [`Workbook`].

Every other part of a workbook value is immutable once shared (the engine keeps versions as
`Arc<Workbook>` and tells unsaved changes by pointer). The active sheet is the exception: it
is the view state of the window showing the workbook, and several windows on one workbook
swap their own sheet into it whenever one of them becomes the one commands act on. Keeping it
in an atomic lets that swap happen through the shared `Arc` without cloning the workbook.
Copies (undo versions, a cloned workbook) take the value at the time of the copy.

28243.name: MAX_FRAGMENT_DEPTH
28243.docs: Deepest element nesting accepted in a kept fragment.

9061.name: walk_enabled
9061.docs: Calls `f(path, id, params)` for each enabled command step (skipping disabled steps' bodies).

14293.name: engineering
14293.docs:
Engineering functions: base conversion, bit operations, unit conversion, error function,
complex numbers and Bessel functions.

15601.name: stat
15601.docs:
Statistical functions: aggregates, order statistics, regression and probability
distributions (with their inverses).

20760.name: selected
20760.docs:
Selected display values. `None` means every value (no filter from this slicer); an empty
list means nothing is selected (all rows hidden), matching Excel's "clear all buttons".

2813.name: category_levels
2813.docs:
Outer levels of a multi-level category axis (a category range two columns wide beside a
column of values: year beside month), nearest the labels first. One entry per category,
non-empty where a group starts: `["2023", "", "", "2024", "", ""]`.

19525.name: name
19525.docs: Custom name shown in the legend; `None` = automatic ("Linear (Sales)").

9280.name: partial
9280.docs: A dry run stopped before this step (path, reason): what follows isn't in the footprint.

6737.name: keys
6737.docs:
The keys of the items stored in the workbook that start with `prefix` (`"macro_"`), sorted
and lower-cased: the first [`MAX_ITEMS`] of them. To read them all, [`items`] takes one pass
where a [`get`] per key would take one each.

4194.name: default_periods
4194.docs: Forecast rows by default: a third of the history, within [`max_periods`].

8045.name: source_path
8045.docs:
The file at `path` as `CELL("filename")` reports it: absolute, so the folder is the one the
user sees. A workbook that arrived as bytes has no path and keeps only its name.

1651.name: python
1651.docs:
The kept results of the Python cells in the pass: a Python cell isn't evaluated, its
result is laid out (an array spills from the cell, as a formula's does). Each one is in
`pending` until it is laid out, so a formula that reads it first gets its new value.

27300.name: REL
27300.docs: Relationship type from the workbook part.

4267.name: accounting
4267.docs:
Accounting Number Format with the currency symbol to use (Excel's own button takes the system
currency; `symbol` is how the control channel picks another one, e.g. `"L"` for lempiras).

489.name: max_serial
489.docs: Last serial that is a valid date in a date system: 9999-12-31 (2958465 in the 1900 system, 2957003 in the 1904 system).

22287.name: view_active
22287.docs: Last selection and scroll position, saved with the file.

4340.name: convert_to_number
4340.docs:
Convert to Number: each number stored as text in the range becomes that number, keeping the
cell's format.

15893.name: convert_replacement
15893.docs: Converts Excel-style `$1` references to the regex crate's unambiguous `${1}` form.

15966.name: array_numbers
15966.docs:
Numbers of a single array-like argument where only numbers count (text, booleans, blanks
skipped), errors propagate. Used for data arrays of statistical functions.

28827.name: missing
28827.docs: Python cells that kept only their value: no such script, or over the budget.

22433.name: store
22433.docs:
Copy-on-write sparse cell storage.

Cells live in bands of 64 rows, each band behind an `Arc`. Cloning a store (an undo snapshot)
copies only the band pointers; editing a cell copies just its band.

8337.name: view
8337.docs: Where the run left its workbook after the last action.

12188.name: trim_to_budget
12188.docs:
Drops the oldest steps past [`UNDO_LIMIT`] or `byte_budget`, always keeping the latest one
(even if that one edit exceeds the budget).

5794.name: solve_lp_tableau
5794.docs: [`solve_lp`], with the final tableau when it is optimal.

9645.name: check_room
9645.docs:
Refuses one more macro in a workbook that holds [`crate::model::MAX_MACROS`] already,
counting the kept ones, so a save never holds more than the next open keeps.

22506.name: take_range
22506.docs: Removes every cell in `r` and returns them.

2016.name: render
2016.docs: Chart layout: title, legend, axes and every chart kind, drawn into [`Prim`]s.

27665.name: FUNCTIONS
27665.docs: Known operator names written upright in a run (`sin`, `log`, `lim`).

9718.name: summary
9718.docs: The summary line, where the − / + button sits.

8483.name: failed
8483.docs: The result of a run that a failed step rolled back.

11099.name: MAX_DEPTH
11099.docs: Deepest chain of calculated fields using calculated fields.

14950.name: detect_season
14950.docs: The detected season length, 0 when the series shows none.

12407.name: bound_tail
12407.docs:
Bounds the undo steps pushed while a command runs (a script of many steps, a subtotal per
group): at most [`UNDO_LIMIT`] of them within [`UNDO_BYTES_LIMIT`], dropping the oldest.
Only steps after the latest mark go: a running command's start, an open group's start and
the end of the last group are positions the command or group collapses its steps by when
it finishes, so what is before them stays as it is until [`Session::trim_history`].

2162.name: frame
2162.docs: Draws gridlines, axis labels and the category axis line; returns the plot rectangle.

29119.name: SHARED_FORMULA_FREE_COST
29119.docs:
What a dependent of a shared formula may cost for free: an ordinary formula cell's worth (by
[`shared_cost`], a formula of about 40 operators and operands), so a sheet of many ordinary
shared formulas is never cut short however many cells share them.

17639.name: scale
17639.docs: Percent scale, or fit to pages (wide, tall).

8702.name: convert
8702.docs:
Builds a macro called `name` from the recorded steps.
`ran` is what a macro or script run ran, by step index ([`crate::engine::record::Recorder::ran`]); a
run without an entry is left out and listed in `skipped`.

3616.name: se
3616.docs: Standard errors in the same order (NaN for a forced-zero intercept).

6232.name: formulas_down
6232.docs:
The formulas from `start` down: to the first cell without a formula, or through the options
row (`{…}`) that ends a model written by Save Model; at most [`MAX_MODEL_ROWS`] cells.

21709.name: PreservedXml
21709.docs:
A raw XML element of an owning part that refers to kept parts, re-emitted on save with its
relationship ids rewritten, or that Excel needs back unchanged (the workbook's `fileVersion`).

5070.name: page_sequence
5070.docs:
The pages of a sheet `rows` pages tall and `cols` pages wide as (row band, column band), in
print order, at most `cap` of them: down each column of pages, then over to the next (Excel's
default), or over each row of pages, then down to the next.

3835.name: filter_values
3835.docs: Distinct display values of a filter column (for the dropdown list).

7686.name: weekdays_between
7686.docs:
How many weekdays lie after `a` up to and including `b` (negative when `b` comes first),
counting whole days; `None` outside the supported date range.

8994.name: MAX_EXECUTED_STEPS
8994.docs: The most steps one run executes (counting each pass through a Repeat).

24398.name: cell_styles
24398.docs: Named cell styles (Cell Styles gallery): name → style.

28249.name: SHEET_ROOTS
28249.docs: Relationship kinds kept from a sheet without a sheet element.

29557.name: write_theme
29557.docs: A minimal, schema-complete theme part for `t`.

15461.name: criteria_mask
15461.docs: Values at the matched positions of `target` for every (range, criteria) pair.

14226.name: aggregate_with
14226.docs: Aggregates one group with `f`, or with the LAMBDA (given the group's values as a column) when `None`.

25779.name: win_ansi
25779.docs: Unicode → WinAnsiEncoding (CP1252) byte; unmappable characters become `?`.

203.name: RangeRef
203.docs: A rectangular block of cells, inclusive on both ends. Always normalised (`start <= end`).

4054.name: rewrite_cell_links
4054.docs:
Runs `f` over every reference a floating object holds (a chart's series values, categories,
name and bubble sizes, and the source block it was made from, and a form control's linked
cell). Every edit that moves
references calls it: inserting and deleting lines and cells and cut-moves (through
[`rewrite_all_formulas`]), and renaming and deleting sheets. `f` maps a reference held by an
object on the sheet named `host` to its new form; text that does not parse is kept. A source
block that no longer exists is dropped.

11756.name: retained_bytes
11756.docs: Estimate of storage this snapshot retains beyond the next workbook version.

27160.name: NumericDate
27160.docs: A numeric `d/m/y` or `d-m-y` field, with the serial it has read each way and its time of day.

28468.name: Group
28468.docs: Date grouping of a cache field.

4127.name: kind_param
4127.docs:
The kind of object a `kind` parameter names: `shape` when the parameter is absent; one that
is present but not one of the names (`null`, a number, an unknown word) is an error, as for
the `object.*` commands, where the kind is required.

5435.name: EvoOptions
5435.docs:
The Evolutionary method's options (Solver Options › Evolutionary). The search keeps no
clock, so the time without improvement is counted in generations.

9286.name: Guard
9286.docs: Checks each step of a real run for writes over data the footprint didn't see.

6743.name: is_item
6743.docs: Whether the names make an item: a later chunk on its own does not.

8051.name: CellDir
8051.docs:
How a cell marks its direction in HTML. Text on a right-to-left sheet, or text with
right-to-left letters, follows its first strong character (`dir="auto"`), so General
alignment puts Arabic and Hebrew on the right. Numbers on a right-to-left sheet stay left to
right so `-5` doesn't read `5-`.

1657.name: python_result
1657.docs:
A Python cell's kept result as its value: an array spills from the cell unless it is
blocked, malformed or larger than [`crate::model::python::MAX_RESULT_CELLS`] (only a
crafted file holds one), which shows `#SPILL!`.

27306.name: checkbox_complements
27306.docs:
For each `xfComplement` index, whether it resolves to a Checkbox cell control. Unknown,
malformed or out-of-range references simply resolve to `false`.

31230.name: Encrypted
31230.docs: A password-protected (encrypted) workbook: a compound file with an `EncryptedPackage`.

22293.name: spill_anchor
22293.docs:
The source of a non-anchor dynamic-array spill cell, from the current calc state.
Anchors, ordinary cells and cells outside successfully generated spills return `None`.

12121.name: unlocked_ranges
12121.docs: Allow Edit Ranges unlocked with their password in this session: (sheet name, title).

9578.name: recalculated_only
9578.docs:
Only a formula's (or a Python cell's) cached value changed (a recalculation, not a write): a
Python cell whose spill a step blocked shows #SPILL! with its code untouched.

10886.name: level_cell
10886.docs: (column, indent) of a row level (Σ Values counts as a level) in Compact/Outline form.

14737.name: interpolate
14737.docs: `true`: missing points are interpolated from their neighbours; `false`: they are zero.

26290.name: THIS_BOOK
26290.docs: Excel's file notation for "this workbook" in front of a workbook-scoped defined name.

5800.name: SimplexProgram
5800.docs:
The linear program Simplex LP solves: the model linearised at `x0`, its objective
coefficients, the costs and rows for the goal, and the work limit for its size.

9651.name: json_bytes
9651.docs:
The JSON format's bytes for `wb`: the workbook, with the macros in a newer format put back into
the `macros` list as the file held them.

27671.name: fraction
27671.docs: `m:f`: a fraction, or a binomial-style stack without a bar.

26436.name: chartex
26436.docs:
Office 2016 chart types (histogram, box & whisker, waterfall, funnel, treemap, sunburst),
which files keep as `cx:chartSpace` "chartex" parts (`xl/charts/chartExN.xml`) rather than
DrawingML chart parts.

11105.name: Compiled
11105.docs:
A parsed formula: field names replaced by placeholder names `__pcf0`, `__pcf1`, … in the
order of `refs`.

8562.name: name
8562.docs: The name, shortcut and description given when recording started (Record Macro).

24039.name: r1c1
24039.docs:
R1C1 reference style (`<calcPr refMode="R1C1"/>`): kept with the file and written back;
GridCraft itself shows and takes A1 references.

17645.name: header
17645.docs: The header and footer of odd pages, and of every page unless the variants below apply.

7400.name: round_edited_as_displayed
7400.docs:
"Set precision as displayed": a number typed, pasted or reformatted is stored as its format
shows it (Excel rounds a constant when it is entered and when its cell's format changes,
observed through COM). Only cells the edit touched are visited, so this costs nothing for
the rest of the workbook; formula cells whose format changed are recalculated, and the
recalculation rounds them. A structural edit recalculates everything anyway, so it only
rounds its constants (a sheet the edit created, for one, holds written numbers).

29198.name: dynamic
29198.docs:
Dynamic-array spill ranges and legacy array ranges: cached values inside them (other than
the anchor) are not stored, so the formula can fill them again.

17718.name: id
17718.docs: The id `pageLayout.pageSetup` takes and XLSX writes.

3622.name: dft
3622.docs: Total degrees of freedom (n − 1, or n through the origin).

11324.name: sample
11324.docs:
Sample workbooks built in code (original content), for the start screen, demos, README
screenshots and tests.

6238.name: save_model_cells
6238.docs:
`data.solverSaveModel`: writes the model on cells of its sheet, in one step. Saving over a
longer model saved at the same cell clears the rest of it, so Load Model reads the new one.

28036.name: rebase
28036.docs:
A relative link target read from `from`, rewritten for `to`. `None` keeps it as it is: an
absolute path or URL, or a path that climbs above the root.

30652.name: rk
30652.docs: RK number ([MS-XLS] 2.5.217): a 30-bit integer or the top of an IEEE double, maybe ×100.

2460.name: r2
2460.docs: Coefficient of determination; `None` when undefined (all Y equal).

14013.name: lookup_equal
14013.docs:
Exact-or-wildcard equality used by MATCH/VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP exact modes: text with wildcards
matches by pattern (only when `wild`), otherwise values compare case-insensitively. Numbers
compare exactly, not at the 15 digits of `=` and the criteria functions (Excel 365:
`MATCH(0.1+0.2,{0.3},0)` is #N/A while `0.1+0.2=0.3` is TRUE).

7619.name: TextNum
7619.docs: Text with a trailing (or leading) number: `Item 1`, `Q1`.

3841.name: set_hidden
3841.docs:
Hides or shows an outline line. A line shown with a zero size (files that hide columns as
`width="0" hidden="1"`) gets the default size back, as Unhide does; otherwise + would mark the
group expanded and leave it invisible (#1714).

9000.name: Bound
9000.docs: An input bound to a range: name, where, whether its first row is a header.

24404.name: macros_read
24404.docs:
The `macros` entries of a JSON file as read, before the engine checks each one on its own
and moves it into `macros`, so one damaged or newer macro doesn't stop the file opening.
Never written.

28255.name: REWRITTEN
28255.docs:
Relationship kinds GridCraft reads and rewrites, or that depend on content it rewrites:
kept content whose graph reaches one of them is dropped.

3914.name: check_validation
3914.docs: Checks typed input against the validation of a cell. `Ok(None)` = valid.

5222.name: shift_cell_features
5222.docs:
Shifts what Insert/Delete Cells moves along with the cells: merged areas, conditional
format, validation, table, filter and print-area ranges, notes, links and sparklines.

25785.name: pdf_utf16_string
25785.docs: A PDF hex string `< … >` of `text` in UTF-16BE (the `UniGB-UTF16-H` encoding).

6603.name: optimal_point
6603.docs:
Whether `x` satisfies the LP (rows and bounds) and reaches its optimum `best` (minimising
`c·x`), within the constraint precision.

22007.name: reference
22007.docs: The reference text, when the first argument is a plain string literal.

25931.name: restore
25931.docs: Restores the graphics state saved by [`Page::save`]; extra calls are ignored.

29782.name: Mode
29782.docs:
Where the formula lives: refs in cell formulas store coordinates; shared formulas store
row/column offsets for relative parts; names store offsets for 3-D refs too.

27239.name: read_text_format
27239.docs:
A shape's text formatting: vertical anchor (`a:bodyPr anchor`), the first paragraph's
alignment and direction (`a:pPr algn`, `rtl`) and the first run's properties (`a:rPr`: size,
bold, italic, fill, outline, `a:latin` typeface).

9292.name: current
9292.docs: The step that runs next, with its path.

24696.name: literal_text
24696.docs: The text this token shows when it has no special meaning in its section.

27312.name: fmla
27312.docs:
Formula text conversion between the model (canonical text, no `=`) and files (`_xlfn.`
prefixes for newer functions).

4279.name: Color
4279.docs: A colour: explicit RGB, a theme slot with tint, or automatic (black text / no fill).

22299.name: remove_object
22299.docs: Removes the floating object `o`; false when there is no such object.

4352.name: format_as_table
4352.docs: Format as Table inside a table restyles that table, as in Excel; elsewhere it makes a new one.

574.name: Blocked
574.docs: Python can't run here: the workbook's content isn't enabled, or this build has no Python.

4425.name: index_of
4425.docs: The index of macro `name` in the active workbook, or an error that says there is none.

12127.name: go_to_recent
12127.docs:
The references `edit.goTo` with `record: true` went to in this document, newest first,
without names, each area written with its sheet (`Sheet1!B14:C22,Sheet1!F19:G30`).

9584.name: shift_refusal
9584.docs:
Why shifting the data can't make room for `fp`, or `None`: the macro deletes sheets or
objects, the footprint couldn't follow every write, or the shift would move an input.

3190.name: icon_count
3190.docs: Number of icons in an icon set (`3Arrows` → 3, `5Quarters` → 5), always 3 to 5.

7041.name: SCENARIO_NAME
7041.docs: Hidden workbook-scope name holding the scenarios as a quoted JSON string.

647.name: Array
647.docs: A 2-D array of values (row-major). Always at least 1×1.

19902.name: source
19902.docs: The source itself, when it is within the length cap.

9657.name: unique_name

25061.name: zero
25061.docs: True when every digit shown is zero (a number section that rounded to zero).

26369.name: is_defined_name
26369.docs: A series name that refers to a defined name (as opposed to literal text that parses as one).

8422.name: note_touched
8422.docs: Adds to the run's touched log the workbooks that changed since `before`.

28985.name: read_workbook_properties
28985.docs: Read workbook-level settings before processing the individual sheets.

11038.name: MAX_VALUE_FIELDS
11038.docs: Most fields in the Values area.

4644.name: Xf
4644.docs: Maps chart-space coordinates to the page.

26442.name: ref_range
26442.docs: A reference's sheet and range (for the row/column direction).

9803.name: covers
9803.docs: The grid covers row `r` and column `c` (else it needs a rebuild with more pages).

25207.name: fraction_parts
25207.docs: The whole part, numerator and denominator a fraction section shows for a non-negative `x`.

12419.name: activate_window
12419.docs: Makes a window active, swapping its view into its workbook. Unknown ids are ignored.

2174.name: Ring
2174.docs: One ring's geometry and separator stroke: the slices of a ring differ only in angle and colour.

939.name: single
939.docs:
One cell of a LAMBDA helper's result, or `None` for an array of more than one value: arrays
can't nest, so the whole helper gives `#CALC!`, as in Excel.

25353.name: numeric
25353.docs:
True when the result should be right-aligned by default (numbers); General text is left
aligned.

7406.name: check_protection
7406.docs:
Refuses an edit that changed what a locked cell on a protected sheet holds (its value or
formula), or that unlocked it, whichever command made it. Sheets are matched by name, so
moving, renaming or deleting a sheet isn't an edit of its cells. A sort or duplicate removal
that moves an unlocked cell with equal content onto a locked one changes no content but would
leave the cell editable, so the effective lock (row and column formats included) is compared
as well.

8714.name: Place
8714.docs: A resolved reference: a block of cells on a sheet.

6244.name: aug
6244.docs: Augmented-Lagrangian value of a point: objective `phi` plus the constraint terms.

11403.name: current_region
11403.docs: The contiguous data region around `c` (Ctrl+A / Ctrl+Shift+8, AutoSum, sort, tables).

26807.name: derive
26807.docs: H(a ‖ b), truncated or padded with 0x36 to `len`: Agile's derived keys and IVs.

14019.name: CriteriaRow
14019.docs:
A criteria row: its index and its conditions (criteria column, database column or `None`
when the label is unknown, criterion).

5082.name: decode_image
5082.docs: Decodes an embedded picture to RGBA, downscaled to at most `max_w`×`max_h` pixels.

1304.name: formats
1304.docs: Parsed format per style; `None` for General, which keeps the full value.

9006.name: wrote_files
9006.docs:
Files the run wrote before the step failed ("step 1 (file.exportCsv)"): rolling back the
workbook leaves them written.

5228.name: slicer_items
5228.docs:
A slicer's tiles as `(value, selected)`, for the UI. `selected` is true for every tile when the
slicer has no filter (`selected == None`).

25791.name: extent
25791.docs: A positive, finite extent (a width, height or radius).

6609.name: multipliers
6609.docs:
Least squares on the free variables: ∇f = Σ λᵢ ∇gᵢ over the `active` rows. An inequality's
multiplier has the sign that tightening it costs (λ ≥ 0 for `lhs ≤ rhs` when maximising); a
row whose multiplier has the other sign beyond its own noise ([`multiplier_noise`], the
criterion the report rounds it with) isn't binding, so it leaves and the rest are solved
again; the objective's value plays no part. Returns each row's multiplier and its noise (0
and 0 for a row that doesn't bind). The work is bounded by `budget` (see
[`MULTIPLIER_WORK`]); past it the report is refused.

28407.name: field_ref
28407.docs: (source column name, date grouping) of a cache field used on an axis.

25937.name: stroke_line_dashed
25937.docs: A line with a dash pattern (`[on, off, …]` in points; empty = solid).

27245.name: plain_paragraphs
27245.docs:
The paragraphs of an equation's plain text, one per line of `text`, each a run with `rpr` as
its properties: the fallback body, and the body of an equation outside the Office Math subset.

9298.name: follow
9298.docs:
After a step that inserted, deleted or moved sheets, rows, columns or cells, moves the
inputs, the output and the ranges of the Repeats in progress with their cells, as the
references in formulas move. A step that deletes one of them, or changes the size of a
range a Repeat is going over, stops the run.

10606.name: chart_rows
10606.docs: Grid rows of the innermost (or collapsed) items: a PivotChart's categories.

10752.name: vi
10752.docs: The value field of the line when Σ Values sits in Rows (`None`: one per data column).

4358.name: valid_table_name
4358.docs:
Table names follow the Microsoft name rules, as the xlsx writer does: letters, digits, `_` and `.`,
starting with a letter, `_` or `\`, and at most 255 characters. Anything else (a hyphen, say) would
read as an operator inside a structured reference, and the writer would rename the table on save.

1888.name: raster
1888.docs:
A small self-written rasteriser: every primitive becomes one or more even-odd filled paths,
scan-converted with 4 vertical sub-samples and exact horizontal coverage (anti-aliased).
Text is not drawn (tests check geometry, the UI draws real glyphs).

19908.name: refuse
19908.docs: Records that `src` was not laid out, and why, without running the layout engine.

21216.name: Command
21216.docs: Runs a GridCraft command. String parameters may hold tokens, resolved when the step runs.

28918.name: with_params
28918.docs:
`code` with every `%Px%` (`x` at least 2, naming one of `params`) replaced by the parameter's
text. Stops growing past [`MAX_SCRIPT_CHARS`] characters: such code can't be a cell's.

8428.name: already_ended
8428.docs: Why an action finds the run already ended: its undo group was closed outside the debugger.

27683.name: MAX_ENTRIES
27683.docs: Most entries accepted in the zip directory.

11044.name: numeric
11044.docs: Every non-blank value in the column is a number.

23905.name: ShowObjects
23905.docs:
Options › Advanced › "For objects, show" (`<workbookPr showObjects>`, ECMA-376 `ST_Objects`):
whether charts, pictures, shapes and slicers are drawn. Ctrl+6 switches between `All` and
`None`; `Placeholders` only comes from files and is kept as it is.

12425.name: hide_window
12425.docs: View › Hide on a window; the most recent visible window comes forward.

7339.name: anchor_mode_param
7339.docs:
An object anchor mode from Excel's wording or the model's: `"moveAndSize"`/`"twoCell"`,
`"moveOnly"`/`"oneCell"`, `"absolute"`/`"don't move or size"` (case-insensitive).

17657.name: page_order
17657.docs:
Page Setup › Sheet › Page order: the sequence pages are numbered and printed in when the
sheet is more than one page wide and tall.

7412.name: wrapped_line_count
7412.docs:
Lines a single text line needs when word-wrapped into `width` points. The grid wraps whole
words (egui's LayoutJob), so dividing the total width by the column width undercounts: each
drawn line ends early at the last word that fits. A word wider than the column breaks
mid-word, the way egui does. (#1969)

11263.name: NEXT_RECORDING
11263.docs: Numbers each recording, so an undo group's mark from an earlier one isn't read as this one's.

16495.name: size
16495.docs: Font size, in em of the equation (1 for the main line, smaller in scripts).

6250.name: nlp
6250.docs: Local minimisation of the model within bounds `lo..hi` from `x0`.

28048.name: notes_block
28048.docs: The shape block of the `n`th notes drawing.

3780.name: sampling
3780.docs:
Sampling: every `period`-th value of the input, or `samples` values drawn at random with
replacement, down one column. The input is read column by column (row by row for a single
row); blanks are skipped.

7631.name: Months
7631.docs: Dates stepping by months (same day each month) or years.

15333.name: odd_first_args
15333.docs: settlement, maturity, issue, first_coupon, rate, yld/pr, redemption, frequency, [basis].

5088.name: wrap_lines
5088.docs:
Word-wraps `text` to `width` points.

Widths are kept as running sums of glyph widths (the sum `text_width` makes), so each
character is measured once: re-measuring the line for every word, or the rest of an
over-long word for every piece cut from it, made a long paragraph or word quadratic.

16714.name: GALLERY
16714.docs: The equation gallery (Insert › Equation): GridCraft's own examples, as (name, LaTeX).

16720.name: em
16720.docs: A finite value within the caps, as `f32`.

21879.name: MAX_FORMULA_CHARS
21879.docs:
Excel's limit on the characters of one formula. A Python cell's code must fit in it once it is
