Starts recording. `name`, `shortcut` and `description` (from the Record Macro dialog) are
checked now, so a bad name or a taken shortcut is refused before anything is recorded.

21221.name: Repeat
21221.docs:
Runs `body` once for each row (or column) of the range `over`, a token or reference; inside
it, `Row` (or `Column`) stands for the current one. At most `max` times.

10976.name: data_cols_exceed_sheet
10976.docs:
True when `col_groups` distinct column leaves (plus the grand-total column) times `values` value fields
(at least one data column per group) already exceed the sheet width. This is a lower bound on the final column count.

731.name: to_number
731.docs:
Coercion to a number as arithmetic does it: empty = 0, TRUE = 1, numeric text parses
(including dates, times, percentages and currency), other text = `#VALUE!`.

23837.name: refresh_equations
23837.docs:
Rebuilds the cached layout of every equation whose source changed (or was never laid
out, as after loading a file). One call lays out at most [`MAX_EQUATION_LAYOUT_BYTES`] of
source: one equation can take a tenth of a second to lay out, so a file with thousands of
them would otherwise hold the app for minutes. Equations past the budget get an error
instead (they show their source; editing one lays it out).

27688.name: names
27688.docs: Lower-case normalized part name → zip index.

14900.name: detect
14900.docs:
The step of a set of time stamps (any order, duplicates allowed): a constant numeric step
(missing points allowed) or, for whole-day dates on one day of the month, calendar months.
`None` without at least two distinct, finite time stamps or without a constant step.

804.name: sort_compare
804.docs: Sorting order used by Sort (ascending): numbers, text, booleans, errors, then blanks last.

26453.name: controls
26453.docs:
Form controls (buttons, scroll bars, spin buttons) in xlsx, from the published ECMA-376 and
MS-XLSX formats. A control is written three ways, as spreadsheet applications expect:

- a control properties part (`xl/ctrlProps/ctrlPropN.xml`, `formControlPr`) with its type,
  linked cell, limits and value;
- a `<control>` in the sheet's `<controls>`, inside `mc:AlternateContent` (it needs the 2010
  extensions), naming the properties part, the VML shape and the anchor;
- a legacy VML shape with `x:ClientData`, in the sheet's VML drawing (shared with notes).

Reading prefers the properties part and falls back to the VML. Values are clamped to the
0..30000 whole numbers sliders and spin buttons take. Controls of other kinds (check boxes,
list boxes, drop-downs, ActiveX controls) are left to pass-through (`passthrough.rs`), which
keeps them unchanged; a sheet can hold both, in one `<controls>` element and one VML drawing.

25218.name: OVERFLOW
25218.docs: What Excel paints when a date is out of range.

18824.name: from
18824.docs:
Top-left corner: columns and rows from the note's cell (negative = left of or above it),
then the pixel offset into that column and row.

12430.name: enter_target
12430.docs:
The first half of [`Session::with_target`], for callers whose closure can't borrow the
session alone (the UI runs commands through its app): activates the target window and
returns what [`Session::leave_target`] needs to bring the previous one back.

7344.name: parse_lines
7344.docs: A `rows`/`cols` parameter: `3:5` and `B:C`, or a single `3` or `B`.

11195.name: MAX
11195.docs: How many functions the list keeps.

950.name: r1c1_to_a1
950.docs:
Converts an R1C1 reference text to A1 (for INDIRECT(…, FALSE)). `Ok(None)` means the text is
not R1C1; `Err` means it is R1C1 but points past the sheet.

12503.name: has_relative_refs
12503.docs: Whether the formula has a relative (no `$`) row or column anywhere.

7417.name: format
7417.docs: Formats a value with a format code.

11268.name: generation
11268.docs:
Which recording this is, and the number the next kept step gets: each step's number is in
`seqs`, beside it, so a mark stays right however many steps rollbacks take out.

12576.name: InsertCells
12576.docs:
Insert Cells shifting down (`Rows`) or right (`Cols`): the cells of `range` and those
below (right of) it move by its height (width), within its columns (rows) only.

29288.name: vml_xml
29288.docs:
Legacy VML shapes Excel uses to display notes (numbered from `base + 1`), followed by the
form control shapes `controls`. `idmap` lists the shape blocks the drawing uses.

11341.name: expand_merges
11341.docs:
Expands areas so merged cells are included whole. Whole columns and whole rows stay as
they are: clicking column B's header selects just B even when B1:C1 is merged, as in Excel.

4947.name: expand_header_footer
4947.docs: Expands a header/footer string into its left, centre and right sections.

1169.name: aggregate_area
1169.docs: Adds one area to `acc`; `Err` is the result the function ends with.

3785.name: controls
3785.docs:
Form controls (Insert › Controls): buttons that run a macro or a command, and sliders and spin
buttons that hold a whole number from 0 to 30000 and write it to a linked cell.

A slider or spin button's value lives on the control and in its linked cell. Setting it goes
through `cell.set`, so the cell's dependents recalculate and Undo takes both back as one step;
editing the linked cell moves the control (see [`sync_linked_values`]). Pressing a button runs
its action through the macro policy with the document's trust, so a button from a file someone
else made asks before it runs anything.

7636.name: Weekdays
7636.docs: Dates stepping by weekdays, skipping Saturday and Sunday.

25656.name: can_encode
25656.docs:
Whether this font can show `c` by itself (in its own encoding; for the text faces,
without the CID fallback).

5166.name: python
5166.docs:
Python in cells: making and editing Python cells, and their return type. This build stores
the code and the last result a file cached; it doesn't run Python, so a cell with new or
changed code shows `#BLOCKED!`.

24421.name: free_object_ids
24421.docs:
`count` distinct ids no object in the workbook uses, sorted: the ones above the largest id
in use while they last, then the lowest free ones. Fewer come back only when the id space
is exhausted.

21878.name: to_file_formula
21878.docs:
[`PyCode::to_formula`] with Excel's `_xlfn._xlws.` prefix: the string-literal form
[`PyCode::from_formula`] reads from files that hold it, and what the size limit measures.
An xlsx file names the code by index instead ([MS-XLSX] 2.3.10.2).

19335.name: quartiles
19335.docs: Box & whisker quartiles; Excel defaults to exclusive.

16792.name: with_expr
16792.docs:
Runs `f` on the parsed expression, borrowing the cached tree or, after deserialization,
a freshly parsed one that is dropped afterwards. Unlike [`expr`](Self::expr) it never copies
the tree, and unlike [`expr_arc`](Self::expr_arc) it needs no reference count or `Arc`
allocation. `None` when the text does not parse.

6547.name: NO_LIMIT
6547.docs: Excel prints an unlimited allowable change as 1E+30.

299.name: CategoryLevels
299.docs:
The shape of a chart's category range beside its values: a plain list, or a multi-level
axis (Excel: a category range two or more columns wide beside a column of values is a
two-level axis, year beside month; one two or more rows tall above a row of values likewise).

4150.name: SheetViewMode
4150.docs: How a sheet is displayed (View › Workbook Views; `<sheetView view="…">` in XLSX).

2988.name: icon
2988.docs: Icon: set name and index (0 = lowest).

6839.name: unescape
6839.docs:
Turns [`ESCAPE`] and four hex digits back into the character. A marker not followed by four
hex digits naming a character (a hand-made name) stays as it is.

30018.name: array_constant
30018.docs: PtgExtraArray ([MS-XLS] 2.5.198.59): an array constant's values in row-major order.

4442.name: chart_pivot
4442.docs: The PivotTable a PivotChart call targets: `pivot` may also be a cell of its report.

30164.name: ICV_FONT_AUTO
30164.docs: The automatic font colour (IcvFont 0x7FFF) and the system foreground/background colours.

21227.name: If
21227.docs:
Compares the value of `cell` (a token or reference to one cell) with `value` and runs
`then` or `else`.

737.name: value
737.docs: Cell values and Excel's coercion and comparison rules.

27694.name: read_optional_limited
27694.docs:
Reads a part the reader can do without (the caller warns and goes on when it fails). A read
that fails partway is charged this part's whole allowance (`maximum`, and the byte that
detects an overrun) instead of ending the package's: the decompression work stays bounded,
and the parts read after it still open.

17449.name: anchor
17449.docs: Top-left of the output body on the pivot's sheet.

26459.name: macro_ref
26459.docs: The macro a button runs, as Excel writes it: `[0]!Name` (this workbook).

9820.name: page_number
9820.docs: Printed page number of page `(i, j)` (in the sheet's page order) and the printed page count.

13671.name: parse_name
13671.docs:
Parses a defined name's formula. Unlike a cell formula, a comma at the top level is the
union operator: Excel stores and shows a name over several ranges as `Sheet1!$A$1,Sheet1!$C$1`.

20138.name: name
20138.docs: The name shown in the Selection Pane (`Button 3`); empty means the kind and id.

27840.name: keep_through
27840.docs: [`Self::keep`] for roots whose graph may reach the rewritten kinds in `through`.

3499.name: input_range
3499.docs: The cells of a range parameter, after checking its size.

11201.name: functions_in_formula
11201.docs:
The functions a formula calls, outermost first, known functions only. A formula is what a
cell takes as one (`=…`, or `+…`/`-…` as Excel takes `+SUM(1)`).

956.name: precedents
956.docs:
Collects the static references of an expression with their sheets resolved; `dynamic` is
set when the formula uses INDIRECT/OFFSET/names/tables whose targets can change.

20211.name: name
20211.docs: The name used in command parameters.

7423.name: value_text
7423.docs:
A cell's value with its number format applied, independent of column width: no `#####`
and no General narrowing (Save As CSV/Text writes this). Formulas give their result.

11274.name: mark
11274.docs:
Where the recording is now, for [`Recorder::cut_back`]: this recording and the number its
next step gets.

21592.name: salt_from
21592.docs: A 16-byte salt derived from `seed` (callers mix in what varies: names, a counter, the clock).

29294.name: solid_bar_ext
29294.docs: The `cfRule` extension that points a solid data bar at its x14 rule.

3791.name: link_target
3791.docs:
The cell a link names, from the control's sheet `host`: `(sheet index, cell)`. `None` when it
doesn't name one cell of an existing sheet (a link into a deleted sheet reads `#REF!`).

29513.name: tables
29513.docs:
Fixed lookup tables: built-in number formats, the legacy indexed colour palette, paper sizes,
functions that need the `_xlfn.` prefix in files, and unit conversions.

21884.name: object
21884.docs: Show the result as a Python object (true) or convert it to cell values (false).

6553.name: min_ratio
6553.docs: The smallest ratio `num / den` over the `den` above zero (the step to the first bound).

13020.name: Trim
13020.docs:
Trim reference `A1.:E10` / `A1:.E10` / `A1.:.E10` around a range: the range without its
blank leading, trailing or outer rows and columns (`TRIMRANGE` with both trim codes set).

4083.name: fit_scale
4083.docs: The scale (sheet pixels per em) at which `list` fits a frame of `w` by `h` pixels.

const.expr: "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\" standalone=\"yes\"?>\n<metadata xmlns=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main\" xmlns:xda=\"http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/spreadsheetml/2017/dynamicarray\"><metadataTypes count=\"1\"><metadataType name=\"XLDAPR\" minSupportedVersion=\"120000\" copy=\"1\" pasteAll=\"1\" pasteValues=\"1\" merge=\"1\" splitFirst=\"1\" rowColShift=\"1\" clearFormats=\"1\" clearComments=\"1\" assign=\"1\" coerce=\"1\" cellMeta=\"1\"/></metadataTypes><futureMetadata name=\"XLDAPR\" count=\"1\"><bk><extLst><ext uri=\"{bdbb8cdc-fa1e-496e-a857-3c3f30c029c3}\"><xda:dynamicArrayProperties fDynamic=\"1\" fCollapsed=\"0\"/></ext></extLst></bk></futureMetadata><cellMetadata count=\"1\"><bk><rc t=\"1\" v=\"0\"/></bk></cellMetadata></metadata>"

11858.name: OpenGroup
11858.docs: An open undo group: what runs on `doc` until it ends becomes one undo step.

6845.name: holds_item
6845.docs:
Whether the workbook holds an item under `name` (compared without case): a hidden workbook-scope
`_gc_<key>_<k>` name, or a workbook-scope legacy `_sc_<key>` name, which is read whether or not
it is hidden. A visible `_gc_` name is the person's own.

22249.name: uid
22249.docs: The sheet's identity while the app runs ([`SheetUid`]). Not in JSON or the file.

8153.name: to_html
8153.docs:
A sheet as a standalone HTML table (Save as Web Page). A sheet with pictures gets the sheet's
own column widths and row heights so each picture and chart (inline SVG) can sit at its anchor.

22322.name: row_at
22322.docs: Row containing y (points from the top), clamped.

30024.name: MAX_PARTS
30024.docs: `Continue` records gathered for one record at most.

19779.name: Icon
19779.docs: An icon from GridCraft's own icon set; `Shape::text` holds the icon name.

26246.name: read_chain
26246.docs:
Follows a FAT chain from `start`, reading at most `limit` bytes. A chain longer than the
FAT (so a cycle) or pointing outside the file is an error. The file may end inside the
chain's last sector (some writers don't pad it, and Excel opens those files): that sector
reads short, and the caller checks the stream's declared size against what was read.

21160.name: command
21160.docs: A step that runs command `id` with `params`.

30170.name: data
30170.docs: The CellXF/StyleXF data: 14 bytes when complete.

23776.name: with_default
23776.docs: A table whose default (Normal) style is `normal`, such as a file's own Normal font.

28935.name: MAX_SHARED_FORMULA_BYTES
28935.docs:
Budget, per workbook, for what shared formulas cost beyond [`SHARED_FORMULA_FREE_COST`] per
dependent cell: a long master copied into many cells is where the expansion multiplies the
file's bytes, and this bounds it to well within a web build's memory.

16147.name: call
16147.docs: Calls a function with array lifting applied. Wrong arity gives `#VALUE!`.

17455.name: enable_show_details
17455.docs:
PivotTable Options › Data › Enable show details: Show Details lists a value cell's
source records only while this is on.

25157.name: approximate
25157.docs: Best rational approximation of `x` with denominator at most `max_den` (continued fractions).

26465.name: Written
26465.docs:
The sheet's controls written out: the `<control>` entries of the worksheet's `<controls>`
element (each in its own `mc:AlternateContent`, with the namespaces it needs, so it can also
join a kept `<controls>` element) and the VML shapes for its drawing.

30316.name: pattern
30316.docs: A fill pattern from its BIFF8 code (fls); unknown codes are no pattern.

3432.name: decode
3432.docs:
HTML text to plain text: entities decoded, whitespace runs (and `
`) collapsed to one space, trimmed. The text only serves to match a cell with the tab-separated text.

889.name: add_cell
889.docs:
Takes a value found inside a reference: only numbers count. `Err` is an error value that
ends `SUM` and `AVERAGE`; `COUNT` skips errors.

20144.name: step
20144.docs: Incremental change: one arrow click or arrow key.

13750.name: range_r1c1
13750.docs:
R1C1 text with `sep` between the two ends of a range; a trim operator never collapses
`R1:R1` to `R1`.

7356.name: edits
7356.docs:
The structural edits the command made, in order (the sheet's name, the edit), as
references were rewritten for them.

11207.name: dropped
11207.docs:
Steps not kept because the recording reached [`RECORD_LIMIT`] or [`RECORD_MAX_BYTES`].
Once a step is dropped, every later one is too, so `steps` is always the beginning of
what ran, never a sequence with gaps.

15058.name: forecast_sd
15058.docs: Standard deviation of the forecast error `h` steps ahead.

962.name: SPECIAL_FUNCTIONS
962.docs: Names of functions the evaluator implements itself (merged into the function list for UI).

8664.name: cut
8664.docs:
Steps not kept: past the macro's step limit (a recorded run of a long macro adds all of
its steps) or recorded in another workbook.

2343.name: forecast
2343.docs: A forecast distance as drawn: finite, non-negative and bounded.

25449.name: parse
25449.docs:
Parses a format code. Never fails: unknown or malformed parts degrade to literal text, and
a code longer than [`MAX_FORMAT_CODE_CHARS`] characters degrades to General.

22906.name: family
22906.docs: Font family class (1 roman, 2 swiss, 3 modern…); `None` is swiss, the default.

25522.name: symbol_code
25522.docs: The Symbol-encoding code for `c`, or `None` when Symbol has no such glyph.

28138.name: SheetIds
28138.docs:
The `sheetId`s of the written sheets: each keeps the one the file gave it, unless another
sheet took it first (a copied sheet) or it has none (a new sheet), and those get the next id
that no sheet asks for.

3797.name: ControlKind
3797.docs: What a form control on the sheet is.

1254.name: criteria
1254.docs: The criteria argument of a database function, when it is a reference.

14115.name: weekend_mask
14115.docs: Weekend mask indexed by weekday (0 = Sunday).

29519.name: paper_id
29519.docs:
The file ID for a paper name. Spelling is loose like `known_paper`'s — spaces, hyphens,
underscores and parentheses don't matter, and the JIS/ISO and Japanese-envelope spellings the
page-setup commands take are folded onto the name in [`PAPERS`].

15423.name: lift
15423.docs:
Automatic array lifting: a function given an array where it expects a scalar is applied to
each element, broadcasting single rows/columns like Excel's dynamic arrays.

21890.name: to_formula
21890.docs:
The cell as a formula (without `=`): `PY("…"&"…",0)`, with the code in string literals of
at most 255 characters and the return type Excel documents: 0 for an Excel value, 1 for a
Python object.

3943.name: check_arg_counts
3943.docs:
Like Excel, a formula that calls a built-in function with too few or too many arguments is
refused when it's entered, rather than stored to show `#VALUE!`. Functions the registry doesn't
hold (special forms like LET, LAMBDA, OFFSET, INDIRECT, SUBTOTAL), defined LAMBDA names and
unknown functions are skipped.

18112.name: XmlColumnPr
18112.docs: A table column's binding to an XML map (`<xmlColumnPr>`).

29738.name: xls
29738.docs:
Legacy Excel 97-2003 `.xls` (BIFF8) import, implemented from Microsoft's public
specifications [MS-CFB] (the compound file container) and [MS-XLS] (the Workbook stream):
<https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/office_file_formats/ms-xls/cd03cb5f-ca02-4934-a391-bb674cb8aa06>.

Read: worksheets, shared strings, cell values, formulas (text and cached results, including
shared and array formulas), cell formatting (number formats, fonts, fills, borders,
alignment, protection, the colour palette and user-defined cell styles), the 1904 date
system, merged cells, column widths, row heights, defined names, print areas, print titles
and the calculation settings (mode, iteration, precision as displayed). Everything else
(charts, pictures, comments, conditional formats, validation, macros) is skipped with a
warning.
Encrypted workbooks and pre-BIFF8 versions are refused.

5397.name: score
5397.docs: Scores `x`; `None` once the budget is spent.

9394.name: follow_place
9394.docs:
Where the cells of `p` are after a step: on the same sheet wherever it moved (`pairs`, from
[`pair_sheets`]), and moved by each structural edit the step made there, or `None` when the
step deleted them (or their sheet).

13245.name: Call
13245.docs: Function call; the name is upper-case without `_xlfn.`.

6851.name: string_literals
6851.docs: Concatenates the string literals of a `"a"&"b""c"` formula (anything outside them is ignored).

4308.name: formulas
4308.docs: Formulas tab: AutoSum, Insert Function, names, auditing, calculation.

6924.name: criterion_matches
6924.docs: Does a list value match one criteria cell's value (Excel's advanced-filter semantics)?

26179.name: SIGNATURE
26179.docs: The CFB signature at the start of the file.

28868.name: read
28868.docs:
Reads the workbook's Python part, if it has one. A damaged part is a warning: its cells keep
their values.

3292.name: HtmlCell
3292.docs:
One table cell: its visible text, the number the source recorded for it, if any, and whether
it is a header cell (`<th>`).

28941.name: next_object_id
28941.docs: A fresh id for a chart, picture, shape or table.

20077.name: Selection
20077.docs: The selection when the button is pressed.

3438.name: MAX_OUTPUT_CELLS
3438.docs: Most cells a report may write.

4746.name: draw_checkbox
4746.docs: A checkbox centred in the cell: white with a grey outline, or green with a white tick.

12448.name: truncate_journal
12448.docs: Cuts the journal back to its first `keep` entries, with its size bookkeeping.

20150.name: display_name
20150.docs: The name shown for the control: its own, else `Button 3`, `Slider 4`, `Spin Button 5`.

13756.name: print
13756.docs: Prints an expression in A1 notation.

3511.name: FnHost
3511.docs: Host services for calling worksheet functions directly.

26617.name: Ctx
26617.docs: State shared while reading one package.

27925.name: shape_spans
27925.docs: Byte ranges of the `<v:shape …>…</v:shape>` (or self-closed) elements in VML text.

4892.name: fields_to_codes
4892.docs:
The inverse of [`codes_to_fields`]: field names become codes again; a dangling `&` at the end
becomes a literal ampersand so it can't swallow the next section's code.

2349.name: clip_unit
2349.docs:
Clips a sampled polyline in plot fractions (`None` = gap) to the plot box (the unit
square), returning the visible runs.

13902.name: parse_arg_truncated
13902.docs:
Parses a criteria argument of an *IFS function with two or more criteria pairs. Excel
doesn't reject a longer text criterion there: it matches its first 255 UTF-16 code units
(checked on Excel 2016 and Microsoft 365 with COUNTIFS, SUMIFS, AVERAGEIFS, MAXIFS and
MINIFS). A cut through a surrogate pair matches nothing; see `Operand::CutText`.

25455.name: is_date
25455.docs: True when the code contains date or time tokens.

3730.name: num_or
3730.docs: A number parameter, `default` when absent or blank.

8889.name: plain_ref
8889.docs: `A1`, `'My Sheet'!A1:B2` or a defined name or table.

3803.name: ObjKind
3803.docs:
The kinds of floating object a sheet holds. Commands name an object by kind and
workbook-unique id (`{kind: "chart", id}`); [`ObjKind::name`] is that parameter's spelling.
Equations are stored as shapes ([`ShapeKind::Equation`]) but select, open and delete as their
own kind.

15356.name: solve_rate
15356.docs:
Tries Newton from the guess and a few fallback starting points; then bisection over a
bracket if one can be found.

14121.name: advance
14121.docs: Moves `n` (> 0) working days from `start` in direction `dir`, ignoring holidays.

21823.name: Preserved
21823.docs:
Unmodelled content kept for one owner (the workbook, which also holds package-root content,
or one sheet).

15429.name: lookup
15429.docs:
Lookup and reference functions over evaluated arrays: VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, LOOKUP, MATCH,
XLOOKUP, XMATCH, INDEX, ROWS, COLUMNS, TRANSPOSE, ADDRESS.

Reference-only behaviour (INDEX returning a reference, OFFSET, ROW…) belongs to the host.

5184.name: allow_edit_ranges
5184.docs:
Review › Allow Edit Ranges: list, add, modify or delete the ranges that stay editable on a
protected sheet, or unlock a password range for this session.

27055.name: DateRule
27055.docs: What a column's numeric dates say about the order of day and month.

30906.name: MAX_XML_NODES
30906.docs:
Most elements kept in one part's parsed XML tree: an emptied `El` costs well over a hundred
bytes, so a highly-compressible part of endless empty elements could fit the package byte
limit and still take gigabytes of tree before any semantic check ran. Parts whose big runs
matter (worksheet rows, shared strings) are streamed instead and never hold this tree.

28363.name: CachesIn
28363.docs: Workbook-level pivot cache lookup, filled from `<pivotCaches>`; caches are parsed once.

30979.name: parse_streaming
30979.docs:
Parses a part; complete elements named in `split` that are children or grandchildren of the
root (`sst/si`, `worksheet/sheetData/row`) are handed to `cb` and not kept in the returned
tree. Deeper elements of the same name (the `xdr:row` of a form control's anchor) stay in the
tree.

15648.name: aggregate_values_k
15648.docs:
AGGREGATE codes 14 = LARGE, 15 = SMALL, 16 = PERCENTILE.INC, 17 = QUARTILE.INC,
18 = PERCENTILE.EXC, 19 = QUARTILE.EXC with their `k` argument; codes 1–13 delegate to
[`aggregate_values`].

28509.name: Key
28509.docs: Identity of a shared item (text items match case-insensitively, as in Excel).

8019.name: WRONG_PASSWORD
8019.docs: The error for a wrong password contains this.

11943.name: wb
11943.docs: Source workbook snapshot, sheet and range.

1698.name: spill_blocked
1698.docs:
Whether an array result at `k` can't spill: it is in a table, or its area runs off the sheet,
overlaps merged cells, holds other cells, or another formula's spill (unless that formula is
recalculated in this pass, and so may spill elsewhere now).

9400.name: log_full
9400.docs:
The dry run wrote more cells than the touch log keeps, so writes that kept a cell's value
may be missing from `cells`: a shift cannot trust the block.

1771.name: evaluate
1771.docs:
Evaluates a formula in the context of a cell without storing it (conditional formats, data
validation, Evaluate Formula, Name Manager previews, the CLI `eval`).

4387.name: MAX_OBJECT_SIZE
4387.docs:
Largest width or height (points) `object.move` and `chart.set` give an object that is not
already larger: see [`size_cap`].

26185.name: ENCRYPTED_STREAMS
26185.docs: Stream names that mark an encrypted (password-protected) OOXML package.

30109.name: after
30109.docs:
Bytes in every part after the current one, kept up to date as parts advance, so
`remaining()` is constant-time however many `Continue` records a string session crosses.

28874.name: Code
28874.docs: A Python cell with this code.

14851.name: Series
14851.docs: An evenly spaced series built from a values/timeline pair.

25169.name: render_fraction
25169.docs:
A fraction section is `[whole] [sep] num [lit] / [lit] den`: the numerator is the run of
placeholders ending at the last one before the bar, the whole part is every placeholder
before it (literals between them stay), `sep` the literals between the two parts.

Observed Excel behaviour: when the whole part shows no digit its separator disappears (or
becomes spaces when the whole part or the numerator has a `?`); when the fraction is zero and
the numerator has no `0` placeholder, the separator, numerator, bar and denominator disappear
(or become spaces when any part has a `?`) and the whole part shows at least `0`.

7222.name: shortcut_mac
7222.docs:
macOS override when its key differs. Equal to `shortcut` marks a Mac-only shortcut
(Align Left/Center): other platforms show none. See [`CommandInfo::shortcut_for_platform`].

12381.name: journal
12381.docs: Commands run so far, without their passwords ([`cmd::journal_params`]).

3444.name: MAX_OUTCOMES
3444.docs: Most trials of a binomial draw, and the farthest Poisson outcome considered.

12454.name: is_recording
12454.docs: Whether the recording buffer is collecting commands.

974.name: LAMBDA_FUEL
974.docs:
Lambda invocations one cell may make. A semantically bounded formula in Excel can invoke
its lambda at most once per cell of an array (capped here by `MAX_CELLS`), so this covers
every legitimate call; hostile work that grows past one dimension (a LAMBDA that recurses
or nest `MAP` into `MAP`) then stops at the same bound instead of squaring.

26623.name: STANDARD_SPIN_COUNT
26623.docs: Standard encryption always iterates this many times.

27931.name: merge_vml
27931.docs:
Kept VML (controls, OLE objects) plus GridCraft's note and form control shapes: ours get ids
in fresh shape blocks so they can't collide with the kept shapes the sheet XML refers to.

9984.name: PivotFilter
9984.docs: A report filter (or, for a field also in Rows/Columns, its hidden-items filter).

21537.name: verify
21537.docs:
Whether `password` matches. `Err` when the hash can't be checked (unsupported algorithm,
broken base64, spin count over [`MAX_SPIN_COUNT`]).

13908.name: matches
13908.docs: Whether a cell value satisfies the criterion.

25461.name: format_number
25461.docs: Formats a number. The flag is true when the value cannot be shown (date out of range).

15216.name: vdb_schedule
15216.docs: Per-period declining-balance depreciation with optional switch to straight line.

4971.name: hf_sides
4971.docs:
Left and right margins, in points, that header and footer sections line up with: the
page's side margins with Align with Page Margins on, otherwise 0.7 inch on each side, at
most a quarter of the page width.

2428.name: MAX_TRENDLINES
2428.docs: Cap on trendlines drawn per series.

10130.name: CalcSet
10130.docs: A PivotTable's calculated fields, compiled against its source headers.

3736.name: Table
3736.docs:
A distribution on whole numbers tabulated for inversion sampling: the cumulative
probabilities of `first`, `first + 1`, … up to the last outcome that matters.

15289.name: n
15289.docs: Coupons after the first coupon up to maturity.

17905.name: security_descriptor
17905.docs: Windows permissions (`securityDescriptor`), kept as read from the file.

3809.name: Trust
3809.docs:
Whether a document's active content (macros) may run without asking the person first. There
is no default: whoever makes a document says where it came from ([`DocState::new`]), so a new
way of building one from bytes can't come out trusted by omission.

29458.name: num_fmt_code
29458.docs:
A number format by id. Custom formats are built once and shared (`NumFmt` is an `Arc`), so
many cell formats naming one long code don't each copy it.

11511.name: uid
11511.docs:
Identifies this open workbook for the rest of the session: it never changes while the
workbook is open (saving, renaming, reordering) and is never reused for another one.

28223.name: chart_sheet_usable
28223.docs:
Whether a kept chart sheet can be written back: its chart's series must still refer to sheets
that exist under the same names (the chart is kept as it was, so a series on a deleted or
renamed sheet would be left pointing at nothing), and no worksheet may have taken its name.

15435.name: bsearch_first
15435.docs:
Binary search for the first entry not ordered before the needle (`>= x` ascending, `<= x`
descending).

26988.name: agile_descriptor
26988.docs: `xml` is the XML encryption descriptor after the 8-byte version and reserved field.

3955.name: slide_together
3955.docs:
Excel copies a multi-area selection only when the areas line up: all cover the same rows (they
slide together side by side, left to right) or all cover the same columns (stacked, top to
bottom), without overlapping. Returns a copy of the workbook whose sheet holds the areas packed
into one block at the first area's place, and that block. Formulas travel as their values, as
in Excel. `None` when the areas don't line up.

14273.name: with_subtotals
14273.docs:
GROUPBY's subtotals: `lines` (`key_cols` keys, then values) with the lines of each group of a
key level kept together in the order the groups first appear, and for every key level above
`depth` a line after the group (before it when `before`): the group's keys, blanks for the deeper
keys, and the values aggregated over the group's source rows (`rows_of` maps a line's keys to them).

No recursion, so a deep total depth can't exhaust the stack: each line gets the id of its key
prefix at every level (ids count up as prefixes first appear), a stable sort by those ids brings
each group together, and one walk adds a subtotal where a group starts or ends. `fits` gets the
line count as the groups are found, so an oversized result is refused before it is built.

24591.name: builtin_id
24591.docs: Id of a built-in format code. Matching ignores case and backslash escapes.

4101.name: extra
4101.docs:
More ribbon commands: Chart Design and Format, object arrangement, workbook views, table
tools, Get Data, scripts (Automate), cell checkboxes, theme colours and fonts.

7952.name: r1c1_formula_to_a1
7952.docs:
Rewrites the R1C1 references in a SYLK formula as A1 references for the cell at `at`:
`RC[-1]` → `B2`, `R1C1` → `$A$1`, `R[-2]C:R[-1]C` → `D2:D3`, a whole column `C4` → `$D:$D` and
a whole row `R3` → `$3:$3`. Text in quotes and quoted sheet names are left alone; a reference
off the sheet becomes `#REF!`.

11803.name: group_rollback
11803.docs:
Ends an undo group by putting back the workbook, selection, undo and redo history as they
were when it began.

27207.name: ReadReport
27207.docs: What a lenient read skipped or repaired.

20813.name: MAX_MACRO_DEPTH
20813.docs: How deeply Repeat and If may nest (a top-level step is at depth 1).

4174.name: object_params
4174.docs: Copy of the params that is always a JSON object, so keys can be assigned; any other JSON value counts as no params (like null).

8025.name: decrypt_message
8025.docs: What to tell the user when an encrypted workbook can't be decrypted. Never quotes the password.

1631.name: used
1631.docs:
Used range per sheet: the workbook doesn't change during a pass, and working it out walks
every row, so once per sheet rather than once per range read.

11949.name: text
11949.docs: Plain text (tab-separated) for the system clipboard.

18416.name: Expression
18416.docs: Custom formula (relative to the top-left cell of the range).

4393.name: open_confirmed_link
4393.docs:
Opens a link the user has just confirmed in the host's "Open Hyperlink" prompt: an allowed
address goes to the host (`UiRequest::OpenUrl`), a reference selects, anything else is
refused ([`classify`]). Not a command: only host code that showed the user this exact
address may call it.

26191.name: STREAM_OBJECT
26191.docs: Directory entry type of a stream object ([MS-CFB] 2.6.1).

15946.name: finish
15946.docs:
Turns an implementation result into a cell value: errors become error values, non-finite
numbers become `#NUM!`, text longer than 32,767 characters becomes `#VALUE!`.

4466.name: is_values_field
4466.docs: Whether `field` names Σ Values: `Σ Values`, or `Values` unless a source field has that name.

5847.name: code
5847.docs: The relation code of the saved model (`solver_relN`), as in Solver's VBA `SolverAdd`.

834.name: Agg
834.docs: The aggregates that can fold a reference without building an array.

8609.name: Macro
8609.docs:
A recorded or hand-made macro: a list of typed steps that runs as one undo step. Most steps run
a GridCraft command; Repeat, If and Stop add bounded control flow. References in step
parameters can be tokens (`"Input.col(2)"`) that are resolved against the declared inputs when
the macro runs, so a macro recorded on one block of data works on another.

9917.name: chart_link
9917.docs: The link a PivotChart stores to its PivotTable: `Sheet2!PivotTable1`.

26629.name: BLOCK_HMAC_KEY
26629.docs: The two dataIntegrity block keys ([MS-OFFCRYPTO] 2.3.4.14), one per HMAC field.

2288.name: decimate
2288.docs: Reduces a long polyline to first/min/max/last per pixel column.

29245.name: settle_python_spills_past_budget
29245.docs:
Past the scan budget, the cells of a Python spill read afterwards were kept as plain cells, not
as its spilled values, and a result rebuilt over them would block itself. Every Python spill of
such a sheet keeps its values as plain values instead, with no live spill.

26702.name: Agile
26702.docs: The XML descriptor after the version and reserved field.

6212.name: EVALS_NAME
6212.docs:
The evaluation limit and the generations without improvement have no Excel equivalent:
Excel's `solver_itr` counts iterations (100 by default) and `solver_mni` seconds, so a
workbook from Excel would cut GridCraft's search short. They are saved under GridCraft's own
names, which Excel ignores.

1126.name: stack_position
1126.docs: The address of a local variable, which shows how far down the native stack this call is.

8828.name: active_sheet
8828.docs: The sheet a reference without a sheet name is on.

17838.name: password_hash
17838.docs:
The non-cryptographic password hash older GridCraft versions stored for sheet protection
(only verified now, see [`SheetProtection::legacy_password_hash`]).

15295.name: OddFirst
15295.docs: The odd-first-period terms that ODDFPRICE and ODDFYIELD share.

14133.name: from_rows
14133.docs: Builds an array from rows (all rows padded to the widest with `pad`). Empty → `#CALC!`.

9120.name: ColType
9120.docs: What a column of an input must hold. Empty cells pass unless the input is `non_empty`.

14279.name: bessel_j
14279.docs:
J_n(x) for integer n ≥ 0 via Bessel's integral, J_n(x) = (1/2π)∫₀^{2π} cos(nτ − x sin τ) dτ,
evaluated with the trapezoid rule, which converges exponentially for periodic integrands.

24597.name: fixed_from_digits
24597.docs:
Rounds the number `digits × 10^exp` (see [`decimal_digits`]) to `decimals` places, half away
from zero. Returns the integer digits ("" when the integer part is zero) and exactly
`decimals` fraction digits.

1564.name: settle
1564.docs:
Tidies the range indexes changed by `insert`/`remove` (queries stay correct without it,
just slower).

8031.name: settle_spill
8031.docs:
Turns the spill anchored at `anchor` into plain values, for a Python cell that keeps only
its value: the range is forgotten, and each spilled value in it becomes its cell's value,
unless the cell holds content of its own (its format is kept either way). The work is
bounded by the spilled values stored, not by the size of the range.

1637.name: suspend
1637.docs:
A formula needed at [`MAX_NESTED`] levels deep: the evaluations in progress are abandoned
and it is calculated first.

20892.name: shares
20892.docs: Whether both hold the one list, with no copy made between them.

1710.name: circular
1710.docs: Cells whose formulas have errors from cycles.

9412.name: conflict_count
9412.docs: Cells that hold data and would be written, plus sheets and objects that would go.

28740.name: MAX_SOURCE_CELLS
28740.docs: Largest source block scanned for a cache (cells); bigger sources are not written.

548.name: parse
548.docs:
Parsing what people type into a cell (and numeric text in formulas).

Recognises numbers with thousands separators, percentages, currency, scientific notation,
fractions (`1 1/2`), dates (`3/4/2026`, `2026-03-04`, `4-Mar-2026`, `Mar 4, 2026`), times
(`10:30`, `10:30:15 PM`) and date-times. Locale: en-US.

15952.name: num
15952.docs: Number coercion for a scalar parameter: empty = 0, TRUE = 1, numeric text parses.

23654.name: scheme
23654.docs: `<scheme val>`: the theme font the face follows (`major`, `minor` or `none`).

4472.name: canonical
4472.docs: The canonical source field name for `field`.

8323.name: runs_while_locked
8323.docs: Whether command `id` (a query when `query`) runs on a workbook the debugger locks.

9631.name: check_params
9631.docs:
Refuses run parameters that would otherwise be ignored: an input the macro doesn't have, an
input given as something other than reference text, `onConflict`, `overwrite`, `approve` or
`timeLimit` of the wrong kind, and an `output` that isn't reference text of at most
`MAX_MACRO_REF` characters (`null` counts as not given).

3237.name: relative
3237.docs: Shifts a rule formula written for the top-left cell of the range to `c`.

2002.name: Stack
2002.docs: Stack accumulator: (axis, family) key with positive and negative running sums.

27651.name: equation_source
27651.docs:
The LaTeX of a DrawingML text body (`a:txBody`) that holds one equation and nothing else: no
text in its runs or fields, and no second `m:oMath`/`m:oMathPara`. A body that mixes text and
maths, or holds several equations, is `None`, so the caller keeps it as a text box (or reads
the writer's fallback) instead of dropping the rest.

9704.name: RESERVED_SHORTCUTS
9704.docs:
Ctrl+Shift (Cmd+Shift on a Mac) letters that GridCraft already uses, on any platform, which a
macro cannot take.

25108.name: fill_int
25108.docs:
Assigns integer digits right-to-left to the placeholders at `idxs`; the leftmost placeholder
takes all remaining digits. `force_zero` shows `0` in the units placeholder when there are no
digits. A blank `?` pads with a space, and so does the thousands separator it would carry.

30267.name: StyleRecords
30267.docs: Formatting records collected from the globals substream.

12320.name: InsertName
12320.docs:
Put a defined name at the caret of the cell being edited, in place of selected text; with
no edit under way, start editing the active cell with `=` and the name.

20022.name: MacroInput
20022.docs: The range a button's macro runs on.

3383.name: budget
3383.docs: Cells still allowed before the table is cut short.

12393.name: script_ran
12393.docs:
The steps the last successful `automate.runScript` or `macro.run` ran while a recorder was
on, for the recorder to keep with that step (see [`record::Recorder::ran`]); taken by the
recording hook.

16244.name: esc
16244.docs:
`s` escaped for element text; characters XML cannot carry (C0 controls other than tab, newline
and carriage return, and U+FFFE and U+FFFF) are dropped, as the xlsx crate's `esc` drops them.

3456.name: confidence
3456.docs: Confidence level as a percentage in (0, 100): `95`, `"95%"` or `0.95`.

29105.name: note_box
29105.docs:
A note's box from its VML `<x:Anchor>` (`LeftColumn, LeftOffset, TopRow, TopOffset,
RightColumn, RightOffset, BottomRow, BottomOffset`; offsets in pixels) and its shape's style,
the corners made relative to the note's `cell`. `None` when the anchor isn't eight in-sheet
numbers.

22711.name: minor_font_ea
22711.docs: The body font's East Asian typeface (`<a:ea>`); empty when the file did not set one.

9923.name: chart_series
9923.docs:
A PivotChart's series for a report written at `origin`: categories are the innermost row
items, one series per item column (column items × value fields); totals are left out.

27943.name: write
27943.docs: Writes the sheet's kept parts and adds their relationships to the sheet's.

2367.name: MAX_LINE_PTS
2367.docs: Lines with more points than this are decimated (min/max per pixel column).

6218.name: model_params
6218.docs:
The model as `data.solver` params, in the form [`saved_model`] returns (the objective
qualified by its sheet).

3675.name: anova_line
3675.docs:
One line of an Anova table. A factor line, tested against the error term `err` (its MS and
df), adds F, the P-value and the critical F.

1132.name: spill_range
1132.docs: The spill range of the dynamic array anchored at `anchor` (`None`: it doesn't spill).

20460.name: font_size
20460.docs: Text size in points (`a:rPr sz` / 100); `None` is the default size.

21768.name: PreservedSheet
21768.docs:
A chart sheet (a sheet that holds one chart and no cells) kept as it was in the source file. Its
part, drawing, chart, style and colour parts are in [`Preserved::parts`]; the workbook
relationship to it is in [`Preserved::rels`].

3821.name: plain
3821.docs: A button's action that xlsx carries itself: a macro on the selection (`macro="[0]!Name"`).

29543.name: agile_info
29543.docs:
The Agile XML descriptor: AES-256, SHA-512, a password encryptor salted with 0..16, and the
dataIntegrity pair (`hmac_key_b64`/`hmac_value_b64`) a compliant file carries.

1351.name: round_as_displayed
1351.docs:
The number `n` as this format displays it: what Excel stores when "Set precision as
displayed" is on. Fixed decimals, percent, thousands scaling (`0.0,,`), scientific and
fraction sections round to what they show; the section is picked as for display, so
`0.00;(0.0)` keeps one decimal for negatives. Observed in Excel (COM,
`Workbook.PrecisionAsDisplayed`), these keep the full value: General, date and time
formats (`mm:ss.0` included), text formats and sections without digits (`"x"`, `;;;`).
The section is picked by [`NumberFormat::rounding_section`], which ignores conditions.
Never returns `-0`.

14285.name: bessel_i
14285.docs: I_n(x) by its power series (all terms positive), computed with a log-scaled first term.

4040.name: reference_parts
4040.docs:
The parts of a Go To reference, split at the commas outside quoted sheet names and
parentheses: `Price, Type` or `B14:C22,F19:G30`. The parts are read one at a time, so a caller
that stops at an invalid part or at `GO_TO_MAX_AREAS` does not split the rest of the text.

7891.name: MAX_WIDTH_RECORDS
7891.docs: Column-width records kept from one file; each can cover every column.

15593.name: erfc
15593.docs: Complementary error function, accurate in the tails.

22060.name: skip_string
22060.docs: The index just past the string literal starting at `at` (single, double or triple quoted).

7964.name: FileKind
7964.docs: File formats GridCraft reads or writes.

1570.name: entries
1570.docs:
Index entries of a formula's precedents, without duplicates: single cells, column
intervals and wide ranges.

20825.name: output
20825.docs: Where results go and what to do when they would land on existing data.

8037.name: find_between
8037.docs: The text between the first `open` and the `close` after it, matched case-insensitively.

1643.name: prev
1643.docs: Values from the previous iteration; cells not in it read their stored value.

4259.name: EXACT_TEXT_WIDTHS
4259.docs:
Distinct texts AutoFit measures exactly; past this many, `Session::text_width` is asked for a
quick measure so a huge column doesn't lay out every value.

8110.name: range_html
8110.docs:
An HTML fragment for the same range as `plain_text`, previously produced by
`display::range_text`. Large copies keep plain text only; never return a partial table.

19663.name: source
19663.docs: Source range when created from a selection (for Switch Row/Column).

1716.name: loops_among
1716.docs:
The circular references of a rebuilt workbook (after undo, redo or a rollback, which put
back cells without calculating them), from the formulas whose cached value is `#CIRC!`:
the listed cells still on a loop, and one cell of each loop none of them is on.

481.name: serial_in_system
481.docs: Converts a 1900-system serial (as the clock supplies it) to the serial of the same instant in `sys`.

4332.name: TRACE_ERROR_LINKS
4332.docs: Trace Error goes back at most this many links; a longer chain stops there.

1789.name: Scale
1789.docs: A linear axis scale: `min..=max` with gridlines every `step`.

4405.name: check_cf_formula
4405.docs:
#1999: a formula that doesn't parse must never reach the workbook — Excel refuses to open
files carrying it, even in repair mode. Validated here so the API and the New Rule dialog
(which dispatches this command) share one gate, the way Excel's object model refuses.

15958.name: boolean
15958.docs: Boolean coercion for a scalar parameter.

8329.name: GroupToken
8329.docs:
An undo group opened with [`Session::group_begin`]. Hand it back to [`Session::group_end`]
(keep the changes as one undo step) or [`Session::group_rollback`] (undo them all).

must_use.reason: an undo group stays open until it is ended or rolled back

12180.name: JOURNAL_MAX_ENTRIES
12180.docs: Past this many entries the journal drops its oldest half.

9637.name: parse_macro
9637.docs:
Reads a macro from JSON, as `macro.save` and files give it. A command step may also use the
short form `{"command": "cell.set", "params": {…}}`.

22498.name: iter_range
22498.docs: Cells in `r`, row-major. Efficient for sparse data: skips empty bands and rows.

27657.name: seq
27657.docs: Children in order, skipping property elements.

9710.name: command_steps
9710.docs: Every command step of `steps` (inside Repeat and If too), with its path.

8475.name: paths_param
8475.docs:
The `breakpoints` list: step paths of macro `name` (one of `paths`), at most
[`MAX_BREAKPOINTS`].

3389.name: push
3389.docs: Appends one cell to the current row; false when the row or the cell budget is used up.

11091.name: resolve_source
11091.docs: Resolves source text (range, table name or defined name) to (sheet, range including header).

8548.name: EXPORTS
8548.docs: File commands that only produce bytes unless given a `path` (then they write a file).

16250.name: node_name
16250.docs: A short name for an unsupported construct, for the error.

21409.name: on_conflict
21409.docs: What to do when the cells the macro writes, outside its inputs, already hold data.

29111.name: MAX_COND_CELLS
29111.docs:
Most conditional-format range cells one sheet keeps, over all rules of an element: every
rule copies its element's whole range list, so rules × ranges must stay bounded.

26568.name: controls_of
26568.docs: The `<controls>` element of a worksheet child (`controls`, or one inside AlternateContent).

16323.name: depth
16323.docs: Depth below the baseline, in em.

9929.name: detail_records
9929.docs:
Show Details: the source list and the indices of its records behind the value cell at
(`row`, `col`) of the report grid (relative to its top-left), in source order. `None` when
that cell holds no value (a label, a header, a blank). An error, for any cell, when the report
on the sheet is no longer what the source computes: the cell's records would be another cell's.

24098.name: scope
24098.docs: `None` = workbook scope; otherwise the sheet index.

27949.name: page_setup_id
27949.docs: The new relationship id for `<pageSetup r:id>` (printer settings).

13853.name: Blank
13853.docs: Nothing after the operator (`"="`, `"<>"`) or an empty criterion.

29257.name: read_form_controls
29257.docs:
Buttons, scroll bars and spin buttons: the `<controls>` list (also inside
`mc:AlternateContent`) with its properties parts, else the shapes of the VML drawing that
`<legacyDrawing r:id>` names (not the header and footer drawing of `<legacyDrawingHF>`).
Returns the VML shape numbers read, so pass-through keeps only the others.

15161.name: shift_months
15161.docs: Date `months` months before/after an anchor date, keeping end-of-month alignment.

8767.name: Edge
8767.docs: It runs past the edge of the sheet.

2373.name: Measure
2373.docs: Measures text width (the UI passes real font metrics; tests use a fixed-width approximation).

6224.name: read_options_row
6224.docs:
The options row of Save Model, `{method, non-negative, …}`, into `model`. Refused when it
holds fewer than [`OPTIONS_FIELDS`] values or a value that isn't a number: a row cut short
or edited by hand would otherwise load with default options in place of the saved ones.

3681.name: known_variance
3681.docs: A known variance parameter: a positive number.

7605.name: MAX_FILL_CELLS
7605.docs: The most cells one fill may write: the size cap the fill commands put on their ranges.

20466.name: align
20466.docs: `None`: the shape's default (left for text boxes, centred for other shapes).

2519.name: terms
2519.docs: `y = a·t1 ± b·t2 …`, skipping terms whose coefficient shows as 0.

15380.name: info
15380.docs: Information, logical, web and cube functions.

24390.name: set_active_sheet
24390.docs:
Changes the active sheet in place, also through a shared `Arc<Workbook>`: it is view state,
so switching sheets or windows neither copies the workbook nor makes it a new version.

6443.name: table
6443.docs: Header labels in bold from column 1, then the rows below them; returns the next free row.

28241.name: MAX_CHAIN
28241.docs: Longest chain of relationships followed from an owner.

14145.name: dims
14145.docs: Result dimensions for SEQUENCE/RANDARRAY: blank means 1; 0 → `#CALC!`; negative → `#VALUE!`.

29549.name: theme
29549.docs:
`theme1.xml`: colour scheme and font scheme.

In the file the colour scheme is ordered dk1, lt1, dk2, lt2, accent1–6, hlink, folHlink,
while cell colour `theme` indices (and the model's `Theme.colors`) use lt1, dk1, lt2, dk2, ….

5208.name: cancel_copy_mode
5208.docs:
Inserting or deleting cells moves the copied block away from the stored source range, so, like
Excel, it cancels copy/cut mode for this workbook (a later paste would take the wrong cells).

9059.name: json_bytes
9059.docs: The size of `v` as JSON text, near enough to bound how much a run passes to its commands.

15599.name: invert
15599.docs:
Finds `x` in `[lo, hi]` with `f(x) = target` for a monotone `f` by bisection (expanding `hi`
up to `hi_max` while the target is not bracketed). Returns NaN when no root is bracketed.

16907.name: bar_text
16907.docs:
What the formula bar shows when not editing: [`input_text`](Self::input_text), with a
legacy array formula in braces (`{=A1:A2*2}`).

20758.name: caption
20758.docs: Caption shown in the slicer header (defaults to the column name).

14364.name: parse_real
14364.docs: Parses a real number written in a complex string (no spaces, optional exponent).

9278.name: dry_run
9278.docs:
Dry run (the footprint check): steps that would touch files or can't be previewed stop
the run early instead of running.

6735.name: ESCAPE
6735.docs: Starts an escaped character in a `_gc_` item: U+FDD0, a noncharacter.

4192.name: MAX_WORK
4192.docs:
Most history rows × forecast rows. Every forecast row holds three ETS formulas that each refit
the model over the whole history (about 3 µs per history point in a release build), so this
bounds a sheet's recalculation to a few seconds: 10,000 rows of history get 50 forecast rows,
50 rows of history the full 10,000.

8043.name: source_dir
8043.docs: The folder of the file at `path`, which relative paths to linked workbooks are relative to.

1649.name: stack_top
1649.docs: `stack_position()` where the outermost formula being calculated started.

29914.name: names
29914.docs: Defined names (Lbl records), in order; `None` for names that can't be referenced.

20977.name: default_ref
20977.docs: The range used when a run doesn't name one (else the current selection, for the first input).

487.name: days_in_month
487.docs:
Number of days in month `m` of year `y` (1–31), or `0` for an invalid month number, for every
`i32` year.

22285.name: edit_ranges
22285.docs: Allow Edit Ranges (meaningful while the sheet is protected).

15964.name: numbers
15964.docs:
Numbers for aggregate functions (SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, STDEV…): inside references and arrays
only numbers count (text, booleans and blanks are skipped); direct scalar arguments are
coerced ("3" → 3, TRUE → 1, other text → `#VALUE!`). Errors propagate.

22431.name: line_at
22431.docs: Inverse of the cumulative size along an axis with sparse custom sizes.

8335.name: base
8335.docs:
Steps the footprint's dry runs executed before the run (they count towards the run's
budget, not towards `executed`).

12186.name: trim_history
12186.docs:
Drops the oldest undo steps past [`UNDO_LIMIT`] or [`UNDO_BYTES_LIMIT`]. A document with
an open group waits for the group to end, because the group remembers where its steps start.

5792.name: simplex
5792.docs:
Minimises with the reduced costs in `obj` (last entry: −objective). Columns not `allowed`
never enter.

9643.name: count
9643.docs:
How many macros the workbook holds: the readable ones and the ones kept in a newer format
(`Workbook::macros_unread`), which a save writes back and the next open counts too.

22504.name: diff
22504.docs:
Positions whose cells differ between `self` and `other` (stored on one side only, or not
equal). Bands both stores share are skipped, so comparing an edited copy with the store
it was cloned from only visits the bands the edit touched.

9716.name: summary_before
9716.docs: The summary line is above (rows) or left of (columns) the detail.

8481.name: finish
8481.docs:
Ends the run after its last step (kept as one undo step, unless a Stop step asked for a
rollback) or a failed step (rolled back).

27736.name: target
27736.docs: Resolved part name (no leading `/`), or the raw target for external relationships.

9789.name: paper_pt
9789.docs: Paper size in points (after orientation), for the rulers.

29044.name: image_type
29044.docs: Header dimensions bound decode allocations in consumers. Full decoding is left to the UI.

14948.name: detrend
14948.docs: Residuals of the least-squares line through `y` (x = 0, 1, 2…).

12405.name: group_epoch
12405.docs: Counts group begins and ends, so `execute` can tell that a command opened or closed one.

7319.name: journal_params
7319.docs:
The params as the journal records them: secret params are left out, so a password never
reaches the journal dialog, `engine.journal` or a recorded script (saved in the workbook).
Replaying such an entry runs the command without that param.

26574.name: ReadControls
26574.docs: What [`read`] took from a sheet's form controls, for pass-through.

3614.name: invert
3614.docs:
Inverts a small symmetric matrix by Gauss–Jordan elimination with partial pivoting; `None`
when it is singular (collinear inputs).

6230.name: model_range
6230.docs:
Load/Save Model and Reset All: the model written on cells of its sheet, read back from them,
and removed from the sheet.

21707.name: slot
21707.docs:
Which slot of the owner it belongs in (`externalReferences`, `fileVersion`, `ext`,
`oleObjects`, `controls`).

14078.name: computed_criterion
14078.docs:
For the database functions: whether the formula in the criteria cell at (`row`, `col`) holds
for `record` (a row of `db` below its labels). `None` when that cell holds no formula or the
criteria didn't come from a reference.

7684.name: is_weekday
7684.docs: Whether `serial` falls on Monday to Friday; `None` outside the supported date range.

24396.name: structure_password
24396.docs: Password of the structure protection (XLSX `workbookProtection`), never the password.

28247.name: PACKAGE_ROOTS
28247.docs: Relationship kinds (last segment of the type) kept from the package root.

3906.name: subtract_ranges
3906.docs:
Removes a set of cuts from one validation range in a row sweep, updating the result once
instead of fragmenting it again for every cut.

29555.name: script_fonts
29555.docs:
The `<a:font script typeface>` entries of a font collection, in file order. A hostile file is
held to [`MAX_SCRIPT_FONTS`] entries of at most [`MAX_SCRIPT_FONT_CHARS`] characters each.

5214.name: move_columns
5214.docs:
Reorders a contiguous block of whole columns without replacing the destination columns.
`before` is a boundary in the original sheet: moving B:C before E produces A,D,B,C,E.

5287.name: Member
5287.docs: A candidate: its point, the objective to minimise and its constraint violation.

4052.name: rewrite_all_formulas
4052.docs: Applies a reference adjustment to every cell formula and defined name in the workbook.

14370.name: clean
14370.docs: Rounds to 15 significant digits so values like 0.999999999999999999 print as 1.

9284.name: param_bytes
9284.docs: Bytes of parameters passed to commands so far, against [`MAX_PARAM_BYTES`].

24688.name: FixedDenom
24688.docs: A fixed fraction denominator such as the `8` in `?/8`.

6741.name: Parts
6741.docs:
The names that hold one item: its `_gc_` chunks by number (the first of each number) and its
legacy `_sc_` name.

27304.name: checkbox_part
27304.docs:
The bags for one checkbox cell control, referenced as `xfComplement i="0"`: Checkbox (0),
XFControls → 0 (1), XFComplement → 1 (2), XFComplements mapping index 0 → 2 (3). Every
reference points to an earlier bag, as [MS-XLSX] 2.6.230 requires. The XFComplements bag is
the one `xfComplement` indexes into, and Excel finds it by its `extRef`: without
`extRef="XFComplementsMapperExtRef"` it repairs the workbook ("Format from /xl/styles.xml")
and drops every checkbox (#2630).

4271.name: active_style
4271.docs: The style of the active cell (what toggles read).

28685.name: item_xml
28685.docs: A cache value element (`<n>`, `<s>`, `<m>`…); `date` writes numbers as `<d>`.

15970.name: f
15970.docs:
Builds a [`FnSpec`] whose implementation returns `Result<Value, CellError>`.

`f!(NAME, min, max, Category, scalar_args, "SIG", "description", path::to::impl)`; prefix the
arguments with `volatile;` for volatile functions.

9576.name: footprint
9576.docs:
Runs the macro in dry-run mode on its workbook, puts everything back, and says what it would
change. The dry run spends from `run`'s budget: its clock and time limit, its steps and the
bytes of parameters it passed.

17278.name: Rank
17278.docs: Rank largest to smallest among sibling row items.

26288.name: El
26288.docs:
An element: local name (namespace prefix dropped), attributes by local name, children and
its direct text content.

8341.name: stepping
8341.docs: Whether one of the run's steps is running (its machine is out of the session).

9649.name: macro_json
9649.docs: A macro as JSON (the shape `macro.get` returns and `macro.save` takes).

22510.name: shift_rows_in_cols
22510.docs: Shifts cells within columns `c0..=c1` and rows `>= from` vertically.

4563.name: print
4563.docs:
Printing: Page Setup, pagination and PDF output (File › Print, File › Export › PDF).

Sheets are paginated like Excel: the print area (or the used range plus drawing objects) is
split into bands of rows and columns that fit the printable area at the page scale, honouring
manual breaks, repeated title rows/columns, headings, Fit To and centring, and the pages follow
the sheet's page order ("down, then over" by default, or "over, then down"). Each page is
drawn into a PDF with `gridcraft-pdf`: fills, gridlines, borders, formatted text (fonts mapped
to the standard 14 PDF fonts), merged cells, wrapping, overflow into empty neighbours,
conditional formats, table styles, charts, images, shapes and sparklines. Headers and footers
support `&L`/`&C`/`&R` sections and the `&P &N &D &T &A &F &Z` codes.

26434.name: requires
26434.docs:
The `mc:Choice` requirement for a kind's drawing frame: (prefix, namespace). Funnel charts
came in a later revision of the format.

8487.name: recover
8487.docs:
After the `macro.debug` call itself panicked: if the run lost its place, roll it back so its
undo group doesn't stay open.

26507.name: SHAPETYPE
26507.docs: The VML shape type form controls use.

const.expr: "<v:shapetype id=\"_x0000_t201\" coordsize=\"21600,21600\" o:spt=\"201\" path=\"m,l,21600r21600,l21600,xe\"><v:stroke joinstyle=\"miter\"/><v:path shadowok=\"f\" o:extrusionok=\"f\" strokeok=\"f\" fillok=\"f\" o:connecttype=\"rect\"/><o:lock v:ext=\"edit\" shapetype=\"t\"/></v:shapetype>"

8560.name: input
8560.docs:
With relative references, the example input (the selection) as it was when recording
started: the recorded steps may change its values (text made into numbers), and the
macro is for data like the data it was recorded on.

12411.name: windows
12411.docs: The open windows, in the order they were opened.

24037.name: max_change
24037.docs: Maximum Change: iteration stops once no value in a circular reference changes by more.

8706.name: relative
8706.docs:
`params` with references near `example` (on `sheet`) made into tokens; `here` says whether the
step runs on that sheet, so its unqualified references are on it.

17716.name: DownThenOver
17716.docs: Down the first column of pages, then down the next one (Excel's default).

29269.name: charge
29269.docs: Adds `cost` to `used` when that stays within `cap`; `false` (and `used` unchanged) otherwise.

11322.name: build
11322.docs: Builds a sample by replaying commands (so samples also exercise the command layer).

12630.name: map_index
12630.docs: New position of an index after an insert (`None` never) or delete (`None` = deleted).

6236.name: check_column_spills
6236.docs:
Refused when a cell of the model's column holds another formula's spilled values: the
formula written there would block that spill (the other formula would show `#SPILL!`).
`ours` are as in [`check_options_spill`]: a model saved at the same place before may be
replaced.

14011.name: match_from
14011.docs:
Greedy-free matcher: returns the matched length of `t` when `p` matches a prefix of `t`
(or all of `t` when `whole`). Iterative with backtracking on the last star (linear-ish,
quadratic at worst). `(budget, whole)`: the budget is spent one per loop step; a call that
would spend more than it has gives up and reports no match — quiet degradation, as with the
other work caps on far-past-realistic input (an honest match against Excel's 32,767-char
cell ceiling costs a few hundred thousand steps).

5074.name: layouts
5074.docs: Lays out every sheet a print command covers.

6382.name: build_problem
6382.docs: Splits the constraints into variable bounds and general rows.

28180.name: file_index
28180.docs: Where the model's sheet `i` is in the file's sheet list: chart sheets come between worksheets.

8998.name: MAX_LISTED_RANGES
8998.docs: The most ranges a footprint lists per sheet (the counts stay exact).

24402.name: csv_delimiter
24402.docs:
Field separator of the CSV this workbook was read from, so saving it as CSV writes the same
separator back (a `;` file stays a `;` file). `None` = not read from CSV: CSV saves use `,`.

3912.name: list_source
3912.docs:
A list rule's source as a file stores it. A literal list typed without quotes, as in Excel's
Source box (`Open,In progress,Closed`), becomes the quoted string Excel saves
(`"Open,In progress,Closed"`, inner quotes doubled); unquoted, the file would read it as a
formula. A formula (`=…`), a reference, a name or an already quoted list is kept as before.

15465.name: math
15465.docs:
Math & trigonometry functions, plus the criteria aggregates (SUMIF(S), COUNTIF(S),
AVERAGEIF(S), MAXIFS, MINIFS).

5220.name: check_lines_protection
5220.docs:
Sheet protection for inserting or deleting rows/columns: the protection must allow it, and
deleted lines must not hold locked cells.

9071.name: Prepared
9071.docs: A macro ready to run: its inputs bound and checked, its output anchor resolved.

16773.name: shared
16773.docs:
Base64 for byte blobs shared through `Arc` (floating pictures), so copies of a workbook, such as
its undo steps, share one payload.

25783.name: CID_WIDTH
25783.docs: Default glyph width of the CID font (full-width), in 1/1000 em.

16846.name: CellPicture
16846.docs: A static picture stored as cell content, independent of floating drawing anchors.

22005.name: chunk
22005.docs: `s` in pieces of at most `n` characters.

15611.name: mode_numbers
15611.docs:
Numbers for MODE / MODE.SNGL / MODE.MULT. Inside multi-cell ranges and arrays only numbers
count, like [`numbers`]. Scalar arguments differ from SUM: in Excel 365, text and logical
values are skipped whether typed or referenced (even numeric text such as `"1"`, so
`MODE(1,"1",2,3)` is `#N/A`, and `MODE(1,TRUE,TRUE,2)` is `#N/A`), but a single-cell reference
to a blank cell is `#VALUE!` (`MODE(B9,2,D7)` with D7 blank). Arguments are processed left to
right, so the first error wins. The results cached in POI's FormulaEvalTestData come from an
older Excel that answered `#VALUE!` for typed text; they are not the reference here.

25929.name: link_uri
25929.docs: Adds an invisible clickable area for an external URI. Invalid or excessive links are ignored.

19535.name: clamp_forecast
19535.docs:
A forecast distance as stored: finite, not negative (NaN and infinity become 0) and at most
[`Self::MAX_FORECAST`].

5439.name: LpRow
5439.docs: A row of an LP: coefficients, sense and right side.

9290.name: restart_clock
9290.docs: Starts the time limit again (the debugger gives each action its own).

353.name: indexed_color
353.docs: Resolve an Excel number-format color index (`Color1` through `Color56`).

1661.name: converged
1661.docs:
Whether every formula on a loop changed by less than `max_change` in the last pass (text,
logical and error values: not at all).

31234.name: Format
31234.docs: A file format guessed from content.

3042.name: look
3042.docs: Conditional look of `c`, or `None` when no rule applies.

22297.name: object_anchor
22297.docs: The anchor of the floating object `o`.

8201.name: MAX_READ_BYTES
8201.docs:
The largest native file the reader still touches: its own cap plus one, used to stop
reads whose bytes arrive faster than metadata can claim (device files, growing files).

572.name: Busy
572.docs: A Python cell is waiting to run.

12125.name: touched
12125.docs:
While a macro's footprint is measured: every cell a command wrote, by sheet name, even
where it wrote what was already there.

9582.name: ranges
9582.docs: Cells as A1 ranges: runs along each row, then runs with the same columns on following rows.

12198.name: status_bar
12198.docs: The statistics the status bar shows for a selection (right-click the status bar).

19900.name: key
19900.docs: A hash of the source the entry was built from (a quick first check).

9655.name: macro_item
9655.docs: The item key (`macro_<n>`, lower-cased) of a hidden macro name, and `n` when it is a number.

4569.name: Look
4569.docs: The effective look of a cell: own style, table style, conditional formats.

26367.name: chart_name
26367.docs:
A chart reference that is a name: its sheet when qualified (`Sheet1!Sales`), the bare
name, and the definition formulas would find from sheet `si` (none when undefined). `None`
when it isn't a name, or names a sheet the workbook doesn't have.

30218.name: name
30218.docs: A user style's name (empty for built-in styles).

27675.name: delimiters
27675.docs: `m:d`: delimiters around one or more parts, with a separator between them.

26440.name: NAME_PREFIX
26440.docs:
Prefix of the hidden defined names chartex formulas go through: a chartex part refers to
its data by names (`_xlchart.v1.0`), which the workbook defines, not by references.

9801.name: PageGrid
9801.docs: One sheet paginated for the Page Layout view.

12417.name: target_window
12417.docs: Resolves a [`Target`] to a window id.

7331.name: register_test_command
7331.docs:
Test-only: register an extra command so UI integration tests can prove a pending
keytip becomes live the moment its command lands (see crates/ui-egui/tests/keytips.rs).
Not part of the public API; harmless no-op for production callers who never call it.

24043.name: set_max_iterations
24043.docs: Sets Maximum Iterations, kept within 1 to [`CalcSettings::MAX_ITERATIONS`].

17649.name: different_first
17649.docs: Different First Page: the sheet's first printed page uses `first_header`/`first_footer`.

7404.name: TOUCH_LOG_LIMIT
7404.docs:
The most cells a dry run's touch log keeps; a footprint whose log is full may be missing writes
that kept a cell's value, so a shift is refused then.

29275.name: table_columns
29275.docs: Column names for a table: one per column of its range, unique and non-empty.

11328.name: blank_sheet
11328.docs: A blank sheet (for callers that need one without a session).

20338.name: ShapeTextAlign
20338.docs: Horizontal alignment of a shape's text (`a:pPr algn`).

6242.name: is_sheet_model_name
6242.docs: Whether a defined name belongs to the saved model of `sheet`.

30656.name: WINDOW2_MIN_LEN
30656.docs: The shortest WINDOW2 a file holds (the chart-sheet form); a shorter one is truncated.

14017.name: Arg
14017.docs:
An evaluated argument. Ranges arrive as `Value::Array` (blank cells = `Value::Empty`) with
`from_ref = true`.

9004.name: edge
9004.docs: The step ran past the edge of the sheet.

24408.name: new
24408.docs: A new workbook with one sheet, "Sheet1".

25789.name: n
25789.docs: A number for a content stream: finite, short.

11693.name: Confirm
11693.docs: The command would replace something; run it again with `overwrite: true` to go ahead.

19395.name: MovingAverage
19395.docs: Average of this many consecutive points (2..=255).

6607.name: gradients
6607.docs:
Central-difference gradients, inside the bounds, of the objective and of each row's
`lhs − rhs` at the solution.

28405.name: read_pivots
28405.docs: Reads the PivotTables related to a worksheet part.

1521.name: Taken
1521.docs: Range-index entries one dependency walk has already listed (see [`Graph::dependents_untaken`]).

27243.name: first_run_color
27243.docs: The colour of the first run (DrawingML `rPr` with a fill) under `e`.

9296.name: step
9296.docs: Runs the current step and moves to the next one.

10604.name: body_offset
10604.docs: Rows above the body (report filters plus a blank row).

14455.name: Pre
14455.docs: How a unit accepts prefixes: none, SI (raised to `power` for areas/volumes) or SI + binary.

27316.name: strip_param_prefix
27316.docs: `_xlpm.x` → `x` (any case, as the parser upper-cases function names).

26081.name: array_formula
26081.docs:
Export-time implicit-intersection analysis, without evaluating the workbook.

A range is harmless in SUM, but not in SQRT or arithmetic. Keep the result's shape separate
from affected operations inside it: SUM(range * range) returns a scalar yet needs array
evaluation. Legacy array-aware contexts such as SUMPRODUCT already preserve those operations.

8207.name: LinkPolicy
8207.docs:
Whether `link.open` may hand an external (`http`/`https`/`mailto`) address to the host without
asking. Set by the host in code, never by a command, so a programmatic caller can't widen it.

9515.name: saved
9515.docs:
The workbook as last saved: `sheet.activate` and the view commands move it to the
current workbook on a clean document, and the rollback puts the workbook back but not this.

578.name: code
578.docs:
`ERROR.TYPE` number. Microsoft documents 1 to 8; 9 (#SPILL!), 11 (#BLOCKED!) and 14 (#CALC!)
are the numbers Excel returns. Microsoft documents no number for #PYTHON!, #BUSY! or
#TIMEOUT!: 19, 20 and 21 are GridCraft's own choice, after the numbers Excel is known to use,
and may change if Excel's numbers become known.

4429.name: taken_by_kept
4429.docs: The refusal of a name that a macro kept in a newer format has.

1886.name: chart
1886.docs:
GridCraft charts (layer L3, toolkit-free).

- [`resolve`] pulls series names, categories and values out of a workbook,
- [`render`] lays a chart out into a list of drawing primitives ([`Prim`]) that any UI
  toolkit (or the built-in [`rasterize`]) can paint,
- [`render_sparkline`] draws in-cell sparklines,
- [`rasterize`] turns primitives into RGBA pixels for PNG export and tests.

The look (palette, greys, spacing) is GridCraft's own design.

19906.name: holds
19906.docs:
Whether this entry was built from `src`. Over the cap the length is the match (an entry for
such a source is always the same error); within it, the hash and then the source itself.

9661.name: Taken
9661.docs:
Macro names in use, compared as [`find`] compares them, and the next suffix to try for each
shortened name and suffix width, so naming many clashing macros takes near-linear work.

26373.name: cat_data
26373.docs:
`<c:cat>` of a series: a string reference, or a multi-level one (`multiLvlStrRef`) when the
category range has more columns than a column of values (or more rows than a row of values:
year beside month). Its cache lists the innermost level first, then each outer level with
only the cells that start a group, as Excel writes it.

8426.name: drop_if_ended
8426.docs:
Ends a debugger whose undo group is no longer open (something other than the debugger ended
or rolled it back): its workbook is not locked any more. Returns the macro's name when it did.

3340.name: span
3340.docs:
A `colspan`/`rowspan` attribute: at least 1, at most `max` (the sheet's extent), so a hostile
"999999999999" is clamped before anything is expanded.

28989.name: next
28989.docs:
For each lowercased stem, the next suffix to try: a file full of repeated names would
otherwise retry every occupied suffix for every sheet.

26446.name: fill_xml
26446.docs: A solid fill (and outline, for line-drawn parts like whiskers) as `cx:spPr`.

9807.name: page_rect
9807.docs: The page rectangle `(x, y, w, h)` of page `(i, j)`.

12423.name: new_window
12423.docs: View › New Window: another window on the active window's workbook, showing what it shows.

943.name: concat_arrays
943.docs:
`x & y` with at least one array operand, giving `#NUM!` once the texts built so far pass `budget`
bytes.

17655.name: hf_scale_with_doc
17655.docs: Scale with Document / Align with Page Margins (both on unless a file turned them off).

7410.name: check_arrays
7410.docs:
Refuses an edit that put something into a cell of a multi-cell legacy array other than its
formula cell, while the array stays (Excel: "You can't change part of an array."). The array
would show its value there while the file kept the new content. Cells shifted by row and
column edits aren't edits of their content, so structural commits aren't checked.

16493.name: x
16493.docs: Left edge of the glyph's box.

28046.name: reserve
28046.docs:
Reserves a part name GridCraft writes itself, so kept parts don't take it. False when it is
taken.

21652.name: name
21652.docs: Part name in the source file (no leading `/`).

11407.name: tables
11407.docs:
Table styles: how a cell inside a table looks (our own palettes, keyed by the familiar
`TableStyleLight1…21 / Medium1…28 / Dark1…11` names so files round-trip).

3778.name: patterned
3778.docs: Whether Random Number Generation writes a patterned sequence (which uses no seed).
